CFPM: Florida holds special primary election to fill vacancies in U.S. House
There are two big states holding special elections next week on April 1, Team. The state of Florida is holding a special election to fill vacancies in the U.S. House of Representatives, following cabinet nominations by President Donald Trump.
Why are these special elections important? Opponents of voting rights hold a 3 seat majority -- 218 to 215 -- in the House. One media report after another tells the tale -- Speaker Mike Johnson is having a hard time wrangling them all to vote for his priorities, and any dent made in that majority will make it harder for them to pass bills that harm voting rights this year or next.
It all starts with the American Confidence in Elections (ACE) Act which would nationalize voter suppression and the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which would add onerous voter ID requirements, potentially disenfranchising millions of married women who changed their last names. Those bills are just the tip of the suppressive iceberg, with many in Congress looking to follow the election lies to policies that disenfranchise voters and make Trump happy.
We can stop all that with huge voter turnout in these Florida specials. But we need your help to make voters in Florida aware of these special elections, when early voting starts, how to request a new mail-in ballot, and so much more.

name: Jon Ossoff
subject: Signal chat group explainer
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-ossoff.coN5Ny&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_RES_AC90_20250326_PM2_V1_S1&t=3&akid=8400%2E5257348%2EP7-ANy)
Derek, I serve on the Senate Intelligence Committee.
Earlier this week, I questioned Trump Administration officials about the Vance/Hegseth/Gabbard/Rubio group chat on Yemen that also included... _national political reporter Jeffrey Goldberg._
🤦
It goes without saying that accidentally disclosing high-level deliberations about imminent military operations is amateurish and incompetent.
***
The media has focused on the drama at the end of my questioning, when I rebuked CIA Director John Ratcliffe for refusing to acknowledge that this was a huge mistake by the Trump White House.
But I want to highlight _why_ this was a huge mistake:
By inadvertently disclosing the potential timing of U.S. air strikes in Yemen, the grossly incompetent officials on this Signal group put U.S. air crews at risk.
***
Now imagine what would happen to a U.S. military servicemember who accidentally texted a national political reporter about imminent American military operations.
At minimum they’d probably lose their security clearance.
They might be court-martialed.
These Trump officials won’t even acknowledge the gravity of their error.
And they’ll likely face no consequences.
_That_ is what makes the evasion and deflection by Administration officials so outrageous.
***
Now more than ever, we need hard-hitting oversight.
Help me continue to hold them accountable for the people of Georgia.
Help me keep fighting in the Senate for Georgia and our Republic.
[**If you can, please split $10 or whatever works to my re-election campaign and Adam Schiff so I can keep going.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=abs-em-ossoff.OVupfh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_RES_AC90_20250326_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=8400%2E5257348%2EP7-ANy)

I’ve defended voting rights my whole career, and I’m not planning on stopping anytime soon.
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=175%2E181023%2EDlqSEI)
Team — As a national expert on voting rights, and as Michigan’s current Secretary of State, I say this with confidence:
Donald Trump’s latest executive order about voting rights isn’t about election security. This is about one person who still can’t get over losing four years ago. And it’s about power — who has it and who they’re trying to take it away from.
His illegal attempt to deny citizens — including married women, people in rural areas, and even our military members serving overseas — the right to vote goes exactly against our country’s democratic values, which is why I’m fighting back.
As Secretary of State, I helped oversee our state’s highest turnout and most secure elections in history.
**And we did that by making sure every vote counted and every voice was heard — not by taking away voting rights.**
As Michigan’s next governor, I will make sure every Michigander has the right to vote safely and accessibly. And if anyone, including the election-denier-in-chief, tries to come for our rights, I’ll fight back.
[**Protecting voting rights and ensuring free and fair elections are cornerstones of my campaign for governor — and in the face of attacks from Trump, defending these rights has never been more important. Please chip in to support my campaign and my work to protect access to the ballot box.**](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/854?c0=jmb-em-q12025.895N_2&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20250326_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=175%2E181023%2EDlqSEI)

body:
ALL OF IT is on the line this time.
The most RADICAL, EXTREME, LIBERAL candidates are swelling with dark money backing

|
---
| | |
We're staring down the barrel of a catastrophic first quarter.

**On March 31st, the curtain closes on our first fundraising deadline of 2025, and I'm sounding the alarm.** The stakes are higher than ever, and we're still short of where we need to be.

**PLEASE rush in ANY support to House Republicans to help them on their FINAL PUSH of the quarter. **

Here’s where the numbers stand in Volusia County after the initial first 6 hours of early voting:

Dear Peter,

This is Scott Kaspar here, General Counsel of the Illinois Review. This is a tough piece to write. For the past two years, Illinois Review has been exposing the fraud within our state party to help conservatives understand why we don't win races in Illinois. So much of those lost elections keep coming down not to Democrat voters, but to the malicious actions of our own state party leadership. Below is yet another example.

The state party's policy on mailers is that the IL GOP does not oppose Republican incumbents. Well, here is a story where the IL GOP is meddling with a Republican incumbent – a Trump Delegate, to be clear – in of all races but a nonpartisan fire district race, literally the election at the bottom of the ballot.

If you're running for State Representative or State Senate, good luck to you, because your state party is focused on hyper local nonpartisan fire district races this cycle.

Illinois Review is the largest conservative media source in Illinois and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
http://www.twitter.com/illinoisreview?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823 Twitter (http://www.twitter.com/illinoisreview?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)

https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823 IllinoisReview.com (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
IL GOP Funds Mailer Opposing Trump Delegate as State Party Remains Target in Federal Postal Service Investigation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
(Photo collage by Illinois Review)
By Illinois Review

A new mailer bearing the Illinois Republican Party’s postage permit surfaced this weekend in a race supporting preferred candidates against the Trump Delegate incumbent, signaling that the IL GOP has resumed its postage discount scheme – a practice that has kept the state party a target in an ongoing federal post office investigation.

As President Ronald Reagan famously stated, “There you go again.”

Two years ago, this publication revealed that the Illinois Republican Party had
weaponized (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-weaponized-postage-discount-to-attack-conservative-candidates-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) its postage discount to attack conservative Republican candidates during the Spring 2022 primary. Initially the IL GOP denied allowing preferred candidates to use its postage discount, until IR obtained exclusive audio (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/12/exclusive-audio-don-tracy-admits-irvin-campaign-used-il-gop-postage-discount-during-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) from then Chairman Don Tracy admitting to the scheme.

The practice continued again in
Will County (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/will-county-gop-establishment-tries-to-discredit-concerns-over-mailers-but-theyre-creating-more-questions-than-answers-instead.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) races in Spring 2023. The scandal ultimately led to former Will County GOP Chair Tim Ozinga’s resignation.

Sources have confirmed to IR that the matter had been referred to the Inspector General of the United States Postal Service, who still may be conducting an independent investigation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/03/sources-senior-us-post-office-officials-probing-potential-il-gop-postage-discount-abuse-reaches-the-inspector-generals-office-in-washington.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) .

Despite assurances from former IL GOP Chair Don Tracy that the party would stay “strictly neutral (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/il-gop-attacks-illinois-review-over-postage-discount-says-gop-strictly-neutral-during-governor-primary.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) ” in contested races between Republican candidates, it appears the IL GOP is back in the game of allowing its preferred candidates to use its postage discount in contested elections against other Republicans.

This past weekend, Republican voters in Chicago suburb Orland Park, Illinois, received a mailer indicating that it was “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” supporting three candidates for a nonpartisan fire district race.

The incumbent who these IL GOP-endorsed candidates are trying to oust?

Trump Delegate and GOP donor Beth Damas Kaspar (https://fiscalvoicesfororlandfire.com/beth-damas-kaspar/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) .
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
A mailer indicating that it is “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” endorsing certain preferred candidates against Republican incumbent Beth Damas of Orland Park, Illinois. (Source: Illinois Review)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
The mailer includes several allegations about the fire district’s finances, including one claim that the fire district allegedly overpaid for insurance in order to benefit former Cook County Commissioner and Orland Township Republican Committeewoman Liz Gorman.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
45th and 47th President Donald J. Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas).
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Lara Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)

Beth Damas Kaspar, who spoke with IR, found the IL GOP’s involvement in this local nonpartisan race against her, a lifelong Republican, to be “completely disgusting.” She stated,

“The statements on this mailer are completely false and bear no resemblance to reality. I am proud that under my watch, the Orland Fire Protection District’s finances have never been stronger. We shifted the insurance contract away from an agency associated with Michael Madigan’s family to an independent agency, providing better coverage and saving the fire district nearly a million dollars annually. This was a board decision following a regular bid process, and the notion that Liz Gorman somehow benefits from this is unfounded.”

Liz Gorman served as the 17th district Commissioner on the Cook County board as a Republican for thirteen years. In 2018, Gov. Bruce Rauner appointed (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2018/02/22/former-cook-county-commissioner-liz-gorman-of-orland-park-hired-to-head-illinois-tollway/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) her as the Executive Director of the Illinois Tollway. She continues to serve on the board (https://www.rtachicago.org/about-rta/press-releases/rta-announces-new-board-member-liz-gorman?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) of the Regional Transportation Authority.

Following Gorman’s departure from the Cook County Board, IL GOP State Central Committeeman Sean Morrison was appointed to fill her seat. Morrison narrowly survived a Democrat challenge for the seat in 2017, after allegations surfaced that Morrison
penned a letter (https://chicago.suntimes.com/2018/6/18/18367224/county-pol-defends-vouching-for-employee-charged-in-child-sex-case?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) to a Cook County judge seeking permission for one of Morrison’s senior vice presidents to continue to travel on business while the employee was facing criminal charges for solicitation to meet a child. Nineteen days after the letter was submitted, Morrison’s employee was arrested in Colorado on charges of trying to sexually exploit a child using the Internet.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Cook County Commissioner Sean Morrison. (Source: Nancy Stone/Chicago Tribune)
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
Morrison served as co-chair (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=0000017e-6d5c-dbc8-a1ff-7d7dbf990000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) of the failed Richard Irvin for Governor campaign in 2022, where Irvin lost to former State Senator Darren Bailey by 43 points (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/opinion-how-the-il-gop-has-turned-gov-ron-desantis-into-their-own-version-of-the-richard-irvin-campaign-for-governor.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) . During the primary campaign, it was reported by WTTW’s Paris Schutz (https://news.wttw.com/2022/05/13/gop-gubernatorial-candidate-richard-irvin-called-donald-trump-idiot-bigoted-racist-text?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) that in 2018, Irvin sent text messages calling Trump an “idiot” and a “bigoted racist.” Irvin also texted the friend, “I hate Trump too!”

In 2022, Gorman unsuccessfully challenged Morrison for her former Commissioner seat. Disclosures
reveal (https://www.illinoissunshine.org/committees/22433/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) that Morrison spent more than $180,000 to fend off the challenge.

Last year, Morrison joined the Democrats and voted in favor of reallocating
$70M (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/04/18/cook-county-reallocates-70m-for-migrants-from-health-care-to-food-service-in-chicago/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) of county funds to provide health care and food service for illegal aliens in Chicago. With Morrison's vote in favor, the reallocation was unanimous, joining the sixteen other Democrats on the Cook County Board.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/03/il-gop-funds-mailer-opposing-trump-delegate-as-state-party-remains-target-in-federal-postal-service-investigation.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Migrants are led from one bus to another after arriving at Chicago’s Union Station on Sept. 9, 2022. (Source: Chris Sweda/Chicago Tribune via Getty Images file)
Beth Damas Kaspar is running for re-election to the Board of Trustees of Orland Fire Protection District. Her slate, Fiscal Voices for Fire Safety (https://fiscalvoicesfororlandfire.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=5a22fb6c0e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) , includes Republicans Donald "DJ" Jeffers and Bridget Eileen Tolan.

The election is April 1, 2025.

This is a tough piece to write. For the past two years, Illinois Review has been exposing the fraud within our state party to help conservatives understand why we don't win races in Illinois. So much of those lost elections keep coming down not to Democrat voters, but to the malicious actions of our own state party leadership. Below is yet another example. The state party's policy on mailers is that the IL GOP does not oppose Republican incumbents. Well, here is a story where the IL GOP is meddling with a Republican incumbent – a Trump Delegate, to be clear – in of all races but a nonpartisan fire district race, literally the election at the bottom of the ballot. If you're running for State Representative or State Senate, good luck to you, because your state party is focused on hyper local nonpartisan fire district races this cycle. Illinois Review is the largest conservative media source in Illinois and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump. Twitter () Facebook () IllinoisReview.com () IL GOP Funds Mailer Opposing Trump Delegate as State Party Remains Target in Federal Postal Service Investigation () (Photo collage by Illinois Review) By Illinois Review A new mailer bearing the Illinois Republican Party’s postage permit surfaced this weekend in a race supporting preferred candidates against the Trump Delegate incumbent, signaling that the IL GOP has resumed its postage discount scheme – a practice that has kept the state party a target in an ongoing federal post office investigation. As President Ronald Reagan famously stated, “There you go again.” Two years ago, this publication revealed that the Illinois Republican Party had weaponized () its postage discount to attack conservative Republican candidates during the Spring 2022 primary. Initially the IL GOP denied allowing preferred candidates to use its postage discount, until IR obtained exclusive audio () from then Chairman Don Tracy admitting to the scheme. The practice continued again in Will County () races in Spring 2023. The scandal ultimately led to former Will County GOP Chair Tim Ozinga’s resignation. Sources have confirmed to IR that the matter had been referred to the Inspector General of the United States Postal Service, who still may be conducting an independent investigation () . Despite assurances from former IL GOP Chair Don Tracy that the party would stay “strictly neutral () ” in contested races between Republican candidates, it appears the IL GOP is back in the game of allowing its preferred candidates to use its postage discount in contested elections against other Republicans. This past weekend, Republican voters in Chicago suburb Orland Park, Illinois, received a mailer indicating that it was “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” supporting three candidates for a nonpartisan fire district race. The incumbent who these IL GOP-endorsed candidates are trying to oust? Trump Delegate and GOP donor Beth Damas Kaspar () . A mailer indicating that it is “Paid for by the Illinois Republican Party” endorsing certain preferred candidates against Republican incumbent Beth Damas of Orland Park, Illinois. (Source: Illinois Review) CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () The mailer includes several allegations about the fire district’s finances, including one claim that the fire district allegedly overpaid for insurance in order to benefit former Cook County Commissioner and Orland Township Republican Committeewoman Liz Gorman. 45th and 47th President Donald J. Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas). Lara Trump and Beth Damas, at Mar-a-Lago. (Source: Beth Damas) CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Beth Damas Kaspar, who spoke with IR, found the IL GOP’s involvement in this local nonpartisan race against her, a lifelong Republican, to be “completely disgusting.” She stated, “The statements on this mailer are completely false and bear no resemblance to reality. I am proud that under my watch, the Orland Fire Protection District’s finances have never been stronger. We shifted the insurance contract away from an agency associated with Michael Madigan’s family to an independent agency, providing better coverage and saving the fire district nearly a million dollars annually. This was a board decision following a regular bid process, and the notion that Liz Gorman somehow benefits from this is unfounded.” Liz Gorman served as the 17th district Commissioner on the Cook County board as a Republican for thirteen years. In 2018, Gov. Bruce Rauner appointed () her as the Executive Director of the Illinois Tollway. She continues to serve on the board () of the Regional Transportation Authority. Following Gorman’s departure from the Cook County Board, IL GOP State Central Committeeman Sean Morrison was appointed to fill her seat. Morrison narrowly survived a Democrat challenge for the seat in 2017, after allegations surfaced that Morrison penned a letter () to a Cook County judge seeking permission for one of Morrison’s senior vice presidents to continue to travel on business while the employee was facing criminal charges for solicitation to meet a child. Nineteen days after the letter was submitted, Morrison’s employee was arrested in Colorado on charges of trying to sexually exploit a child using the Internet. Cook County Commissioner Sean Morrison. (Source: Nancy Stone/Chicago Tribune) CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Morrison served as co-chair () of the failed Richard Irvin for Governor campaign in 2022, where Irvin lost to former State Senator Darren Bailey by 43 points () . During the primary campaign, it was reported by WTTW’s Paris Schutz () that in 2018, Irvin sent text messages calling Trump an “idiot” and a “bigoted racist.” Irvin also texted the friend, “I hate Trump too!” In 2022, Gorman unsuccessfully challenged Morrison for her former Commissioner seat. Disclosures reveal () that Morrison spent more than $180,000 to fend off the challenge. Last year, Morrison joined the Democrats and voted in favor of reallocating $70M () of county funds to provide health care and food service for illegal aliens in Chicago. With Morrison's vote in favor, the reallocation was unanimous, joining the sixteen other Democrats on the Cook County Board. Migrants are led from one bus to another after arriving at Chicago’s Union Station on Sept. 9, 2022. (Source: Chris Sweda/Chicago Tribune via Getty Images file) Beth Damas Kaspar is running for re-election to the Board of Trustees of Orland Fire Protection District. Her slate, Fiscal Voices for Fire Safety () , includes Republicans Donald "DJ" Jeffers and Bridget Eileen Tolan. The election is April 1, 2025. | Dear friends, Right now, Republican leadership are demanding that their members stop holding in-person town halls to avoid hearing concerns from everyday Americans about the out-of-control Trump Administration. **But here at the California Democratic Party, that isn’t our style.** Last week, we held a town hall meeting in one of the most vulnerable Republican-held districts in our state — currently represented by Republican Rep. David Valadao. And while I was honored to give some brief opening remarks, I wasn’t there to preach. I was there to listen. And here’s what I heard: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104577992/535843100/803820036?refcode=20250326_FR_45DO_RustyTownhall&amount=35&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDhkZDAzMS1iMDBhLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EgRgOeYjLg28eq5KeC7KRve6_c-4eUE7W77NoEV5JPw=) _Congressman Jimmy Gomez, CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks, CA Assemblymember Dr. Jasmeet Bains_ **Carter** , a high school student, is concerned about the future of education for himself and his peers: _“The issue is if we start debilitating the Department of Education, we’re taking away things like Perkins funding and McKinney-Vinco funding. I’m looking at my peers who may not even have a roof over their heads, and are sleeping in cars and struggling to do their schoolwork — why is it that on top of this they have to look at the leader of the free world telling them he doesn't give a damn about them?”_ **Sandy** is worried about the future of Medicaid, especially since cuts to the program are a key component to funding Donald Trump’s tax cuts for billionaires: _“We can’t allow Medicaid cuts to prevail because this is life and death. 67% of our people in Valadao’s constituency are on Medicaid. Politicians have a duty to us, to represent us. They say that health and safety is a priority. How can they justify cutting Medicaid?”_ Farmers are the backbone of California, and **Roman** is concerned about how they will fare given all the economic uncertainty, the chaotic “off again, on again” tariffs, and threats to healthcare: _“Kern County is the 3rd largest producer of agriculture in the country. The barriers that exist for farmworkers to access health are immense. I think that the message I’d like to say is that the crises that our society goes through, farmworkers experience every single one of them. They suffer disproportionately.”_ And we heard so much more. Everyday Californians shared their fears about Republicans’ proposed cuts to the Social Security Administration, shutting down field offices, taking the phones off the hook, and slashing critical services for seniors and working families. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104577993/535843101/803820036?refcode=20250326_FR_45DO_RustyTownhall&amount=35&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDhkZDAzMS1iMDBhLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EgRgOeYjLg28eq5KeC7KRve6_c-4eUE7W77NoEV5JPw=) **Here’s what I know.** The Democratic Party doesn’t have a magic wand to stop Trump and fix these problems overnight. But we will *never* stop listening to your fears and concerns and we will *never* stop fighting for **YOU**. While GOP politicians hide from their constituents, California Democrats are showing up, listening, and fighting to protect the programs Americans rely on. That’s what it means to be California Strong and to be in this fight for the next four years and beyond. **[We are hoping to launch more town halls across the state to hold the GOP’s feet to the fire. clean_body: We showed up and heard THIS... | = | Dear friends, Right now, Republican leadership are demanding that their members stop holding in-person town halls to avoid hearing concerns from everyday Americans about the out-of-control Trump Administration. But here at the California Democratic Party, that isn’t our style. Last week, we held a town hall meeting in one of the most vulnerable Republican-held districts in our state — currently represented by Republican Rep. David Valadao. And while I was honored to give some brief opening remarks, I wasn’t there to preach. I was there to listen. And here’s what I heard: = Congressman Jimmy Gomez, CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks, CA Assemblymember Dr. Jasmeet Bains Carter , a high school student, is concerned about the future of education for himself and his peers: “The issue is if we start debilitating the Department of Education, we’re taking away things like Perkins funding and McKinney-Vinco funding. I’m looking at my peers who may not even have a roof over their heads, and are sleeping in cars and struggling to do their schoolwork — why is it that on top of this they have to look at the leader of the free world telling them he doesn't give a damn about them?” Sandy is worried about the future of Medicaid, especially since cuts to the program are a key component to funding Donald Trump’s tax cuts for billionaires: “We can’t allow Medicaid cuts to prevail because this is life and death. 67% of our people in Valadao’s constituency are on Medicaid. Politicians have a duty to us, to represent us. They say that health and safety is a priority. How can they justify cutting Medicaid?” Farmers are the backbone of California, and Roman is concerned about how they will fare given all the economic uncertainty, the chaotic “off again, on again” tariffs, and threats to healthcare: “Kern County is the 3rd largest producer of agriculture in the country. The barriers that exist for farmworkers to access health are immense. I think that the message I’d like to say is that the crises that our society goes through, farmworkers experience every single one of them. They suffer disproportionately.” And we heard so much more. Everyday Californians shared their fears about Republicans’ proposed cuts to the Social Security Administration, shutting down field offices, taking the phones off the hook, and slashing critical services for seniors and working families. = Here’s what I know. The Democratic Party doesn’t have a magic wand to stop Trump and fix these problems overnight. But we will never stop listening to your fears and concerns and we will never stop fighting for YOU. While GOP politicians hide from their constituents, California Democrats are showing up, listening, and fighting to protect the programs Americans rely on. That’s what it means to be California Strong and to be in this fight for the next four years and beyond. = = = = = = Thank you, \- Rusty, Chair of CADEM | | = Our Democratic leaders are working hard to make California a better place to live. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Healthcare is a human right / Cuidado de salud es un derecho humano
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
TAKE ACTION:
Demand Congress reject all Medicaid cuts
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Stop%20the%20cuts.jpg]
We're entering crunch time. Republicans in Congress are proposing over $2.3 TRILLION in cuts to Medicaid — cuts that will devastate working families, children, seniors, and people with disabilities. Take action with us NOW to call out these reckless cuts and spread the word about how they will harm Texans of all walks life .
If Medicaid has helped you or your family — or if you’ve seen firsthand how it supports your community — speak up and share your story!
1. Go to TOP's Instagram post [https://www.instagram.com/p/DHo__H2REdR/] and tag your member of Congress ( find out who they are here [https://www.house.gov/representatives/find-your-representative] ) to demand they reject Medicaid cuts and protect Texans' access to healthcare. Comment: 'No Cuts to our Care! #SickofitTX'
2. Fill out this quick form [https://everytexan.salsalabs.org/ProtectMedicaidandSNAPNow/index.html] to call your member of Congress and send them an email demanding they oppose these drastic cuts.
At TOP, we not only believe healthcare is a fundamental human right, we fight for it year-round through our healthcare justice organizing work. Contact Irie at ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] to learn more about our efforts.
CONTACT YOUR STATE REP:
Join the fight against anti-housing bills HB32 and SB38
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eviction%20notice%20sticker.jpg]
HB32 [https://www.expressnews.com/opinion/editorial/article/texas-house-bill-32-squatter-eviction-20227578.php] and its Senate companion SB38 [https://capitol.texas.gov/BillLookup/History.aspx?LegSess=89R&Bill=SB38] are anti-renter bills that chip away at tenant protections, making evictions even harder to fight. These bills allow landlords to evict tenants without prior notice or legal proceedings for reasons other than non-payment of rent, enabling judgments without a hearing in some instances.
While authors of these bills claim they will address the issue of squatting, they instead infringe on tenants' due process rights, and will hurt Texans already struggling to make ends meet. These pieces of legislation aren’t about squatters — they’re tools to fast-track evictions and silence working-class Texans fighting unfair displacement.
Contact your state representative and senator to urge them to stop this misguided legislation [https://www.texastribune.org/directory/] .
GIVE US A BOOST:
Follow TOP on Bluesky
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/English%20-%20TOP%20Bluesky%20graphic.jpg]
Yes, TOP made the move!
With how toxic the discourse on President Musk's X (Twitter) has become, our TOP communications team is prioritizing the development of our presence on Bluesky.
FOLLOW US at @txorgproject.bsky.social. [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
TOP Tip: Get those taxes done!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Tax%20return.jpg]
The April 15th tax filing deadline is approaching. Don’t wait until the last minute! File your taxes now and check this important task off the list. Get some last minute tips here. [https://www.cnet.com/personal-finance/taxes/tax-season-2025-cheat-sheet-make-filing-your-taxes-simple-with-this-tool/]
Español
ACTÚE AHORA:
Exija al Congreso que rechace todos los recortes a Medicaid
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Stop%20the%20cuts.jpg]
Estamos entrando en un momento crucial. Los republicanos en el Congreso proponen más de $2.3 billones en recortes a Medicaid, recortes que devastarán a las familias trabajadoras, los niños, las personas mayores y las personas con discapacidad. Únase a nosotros AHORA para denunciar estos recortes imprudentes y difundir cómo perjudicarán a los tejanos de todos los ámbitos.
Si Medicaid les ha ayudado a usted o a su familia, o si ha visto de primera mano cómo apoya a su comunidad, ¡alce la voz y comparta su historia!
1. Visite la publicación de TOP en Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/p/DHo__H2REdR/?img_index=1] y etiquete a su congresista ( descúbralo aquí [https://www.house.gov/representatives/find-your-representative] ) para exigir que rechace los recortes a Medicaid y proteja el acceso de los tejanos a la atención médica. Comente: "¡No a los recortes a nuestra atención médica! #SickofitTX"
2. Complete este breve formulario [https://everytexan.salsalabs.org/ProtectMedicaidandSNAPNow/index.html] para llamar a su congresista y enviarle un correo electrónico exigiéndole que se oponga a estos drásticos recortes.
En TOP, no solo creemos que la atención médica es un derecho humano fundamental, sino que luchamos por ella todo el año a través de nuestro trabajo de organización por la justicia en la atención médica. Comuníquese con Irie en ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] para obtener más información sobre nuestros esfuerzos.
CONTACTE A SU REPRESENTANTE:
Únase a la lucha contra los proyectos de ley anti-vivienda HB32 y SB38
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eviction%20notice%20sticker.jpg]
La HB32 [https://www.expressnews.com/opinion/editorial/article/texas-house-bill-32-squatter-eviction-20227578.php] y su contraparte en el Senado, la SB38 [https://capitol.texas.gov/BillLookup/History.aspx?LegSess=89R&Bill=SB38] , son proyectos de ley anti-inquilinos que socavan las protecciones de los inquilinos, dificultando aún más la lucha contra los desalojos. Estos proyectos de ley permiten a los propietarios desalojar a los inquilinos sin previo aviso ni procedimientos legales por razones distintas al impago del alquiler, lo que permite sentencias sin audiencia en algunos casos.
Si bien los autores de estos proyectos de ley afirman que abordarán el problema de la ocupación ilegal, en realidad vulneran el derecho al debido proceso de los inquilinos y perjudicarán a los tejanos que ya tienen dificultades para llegar a fin de mes. Estas leyes no se centran en los ocupantes ilegales; son herramientas para acelerar los desalojos y silenciar a la clase trabajadora tejana que lucha contra el desplazamiento injusto.
Contacte a su representante estatal y senador para instarlos a detener esta mala legislación. [https://www.texastribune.org/directory/]
DANOS UN IMPULSO:
Siga TOP en Bluesky
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Spanish%20-%20TOP%20Bluesky%20graphic.jpg]
Sí, TOP dio el paso.
Dado lo tóxico que se ha vuelto el discurso en la cuenta X (Twitter) del presidente Musk, nuestro equipo de comunicaciones de TOP está priorizando el desarrollo de nuestra presencia en Bluesky.
SÍGUENOS en @txorgproject.bsky.social. [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
Consejos de TOP: Complete sus impuestos pronto
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Tax%20return.jpg]
Se acerca la fecha límite para presentar la declaración de impuestos, el 15 de abril. ¡No esperes hasta el último minuto! Presenta tu declaración ahora y tacha esta importante tarea de la lista. Encuentra algunos consejos de última hora aquí. [https://www.cnet.com/personal-finance/taxes/tax-season-2025-cheat-sheet-make-filing-your-taxes-simple-with-this-tool/]

If Medicaid has helped you or your family — or if you’ve seen firsthand how it supports your community — speak up and share your story! 1. Go to TOP's Instagram post [] and tag your member of Congress ( find out who they are here [] ) to demand they reject Medicaid cuts and protect Texans' access to healthcare. Comment: 'No Cuts to our Care! #SickofitTX' 2. Fill out this quick form [] to call your member of Congress and send them an email demanding they oppose these drastic cuts. At TOP, we not only believe healthcare is a fundamental human right, we fight for it year-round through our healthcare justice organizing work. Contact Irie at ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] to learn more about our efforts. CONTACT YOUR STATE REP: Join the fight against anti-housing bills HB32 and SB38 [] HB32 [] and its Senate companion SB38 [] are anti-renter bills that chip away at tenant protections, making evictions even harder to fight. These bills allow landlords to evict tenants without prior notice or legal proceedings for reasons other than non-payment of rent, enabling judgments without a hearing in some instances. While authors of these bills claim they will address the issue of squatting, they instead infringe on tenants' due process rights, and will hurt Texans already struggling to make ends meet. These pieces of legislation aren’t about squatters — they’re tools to fast-track evictions and silence working-class Texans fighting unfair displacement. Contact your state representative and senator to urge them to stop this misguided legislation [] . GIVE US A BOOST: Follow TOP on Bluesky [] Yes, TOP made the move! With how toxic the discourse on President Musk's X (Twitter) has become, our TOP communications team is prioritizing the development of our presence on Bluesky. FOLLOW US at @txorgproject.bsky.social. [] TOP Tip: Get those taxes done! [] The April 15th tax filing deadline is approaching. Don’t wait until the last minute! File your taxes now and check this important task off the list. Get some last minute tips here. [] Español ACTÚE AHORA: Exija al Congreso que rechace todos los recortes a Medicaid [] Estamos entrando en un momento crucial. Los republicanos en el Congreso proponen más de $2.3 billones en recortes a Medicaid, recortes que devastarán a las familias trabajadoras, los niños, las personas mayores y las personas con discapacidad. Únase a nosotros AHORA para denunciar estos recortes imprudentes y difundir cómo perjudicarán a los tejanos de todos los ámbitos. Si Medicaid les ha ayudado a usted o a su familia, o si ha visto de primera mano cómo apoya a su comunidad, ¡alce la voz y comparta su historia! 1. Visite la publicación de TOP en Instagram [] y etiquete a su congresista ( descúbralo aquí [] ) para exigir que rechace los recortes a Medicaid y proteja el acceso de los tejanos a la atención médica. Comente: "¡No a los recortes a nuestra atención médica! #SickofitTX" 2. Complete este breve formulario [] para llamar a su congresista y enviarle un correo electrónico exigiéndole que se oponga a estos drásticos recortes. En TOP, no solo creemos que la atención médica es un derecho humano fundamental, sino que luchamos por ella todo el año a través de nuestro trabajo de organización por la justicia en la atención médica. Comuníquese con Irie en ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] para obtener más información sobre nuestros esfuerzos. CONTACTE A SU REPRESENTANTE: Únase a la lucha contra los proyectos de ley anti-vivienda HB32 y SB38 [] La HB32 [] y su contraparte en el Senado, la SB38 [] , son proyectos de ley anti-inquilinos que socavan las protecciones de los inquilinos, dificultando aún más la lucha contra los desalojos. Estos proyectos de ley permiten a los propietarios desalojar a los inquilinos sin previo aviso ni procedimientos legales por razones distintas al impago del alquiler, lo que permite sentencias sin audiencia en algunos casos. Si bien los autores de estos proyectos de ley afirman que abordarán el problema de la ocupación ilegal, en realidad vulneran el derecho al debido proceso de los inquilinos y perjudicarán a los tejanos que ya tienen dificultades para llegar a fin de mes. Estas leyes no se centran en los ocupantes ilegales; son herramientas para acelerar los desalojos y silenciar a la clase trabajadora tejana que lucha contra el desplazamiento injusto. Contacte a su representante estatal y senador para instarlos a detener esta mala legislación. [] DANOS UN IMPULSO: Siga TOP en Bluesky [] Sí, TOP dio el paso. name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Hollywood has done quite enough
body:
You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Fellow Conservative, As someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life, I want to say: **_You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children._** Today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ze16bcuhgb7sk9s8qbfl8trch2p7v23set778hso_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1hm9or4sdh2bs)
---
| | And the result of this constant propaganda? An upside-down world where children lecture you on what you can and cannot say......and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas. But you and I know your ideas aren’t old-fashioned or mean at all. They are the same biblical values that made America the greatest country on earth. **That’s why I’m reaching out to you. Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. ** **[**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children's television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlif2av3qjab07ravipf39bdj37h4og2q67f4jtg_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1hm9or4sdh2bs)** And it's only possible with the help of motivated Christians who want to see a Christian resurgence in America like you. Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. This ground-breaking live-action television show captivates children... ...but more importantly, it builds their character at the same time. Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. **[**Because I can't beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a Founding Supporter.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zd093j4ecum9iqqqa4ijum3tmdd6437695egeog8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1hm9or4sdh2bs)** Season One of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ has ten lesson-filled episodes planned. And each episode costs around $70,000 to produce. I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously we won’t work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $70,000 per episode.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za84mdkt7bsete146b8a818m9o78hjucbiuv5ci8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1hm9or4sdh2bs) ** Whether you can send $35, $50,000, or anything in between, or anything higher or lower -- please know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated. As your special "Thank You" for joining me as a **Founding Supporter** at the $35 and above level, we’ll send you**** all ten episodes of** _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ **for your family to enjoy**** FREE on DVD.** ** Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes. And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth. Thank you for joining us as a **Founding Supporter. **

name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zd1hgulslv6kqi4o1a6n971jpntv432mv88vshg8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1hm9or5clh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbaamo376hi82ggrv7b4bmjcc2s298fr9tj61kh0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1hm9or5clh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz
---
P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I’ll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zht2jff47ahici8msiemqe74fasueo3mt79v0a18_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1hm9or5clh2bs)**

body:

---

An upside-down world where children lecture you on what you can and cannot say......and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas. But you and I know your ideas aren’t old-fashioned or mean at all. They are the same biblical values that made America the greatest country on earth. **That’s why I’m reaching out to you. Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. ** **[**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children's television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z0366c7ldrphj8okfvfg3257m3gmmgm5vi25plvg_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jm8ob4c1h2bs)** And it's only possible with the help of motivated Christians who want to see a Christian resurgence in America like you. Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. This ground-breaking live-action television show captivates children... ...but more importantly, it builds their character at the same time. Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. **[**Because I can't beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a Founding Supporter.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zgnus99cnfoa996da3dgk955dn60sa8t6chubjbo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jm8ob4c1h2bs)** Season One of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ has ten lesson-filled episodes planned. And each episode costs around $70,000 to produce. I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously we won’t work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $70,000 per episode.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zo0cot2855queuelqs31b6ohst1hfn6im1vp0c78_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jm8ob4c1h2bs) ** Whether you can send $35, $50,000, or anything in between, or anything higher or lower -- please know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated. As your special "Thank You" for joining me as a **Founding Supporter** at the $35 and above level, we’ll send you**** all ten episodes of** _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ **for your family to enjoy**** FREE on DVD.** ** Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zoql9qs27kudjgs78k4kkjgb9uhb0oae67vedtm8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jmcoj2cth2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z601cpanbarb11smorlkln6tasujr9nc0d4cvako_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jmao30cjh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zjru1863n3uhq4hbk703c693dt37aj3i8um25nvo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jmao30cjh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,

David Horowitz

name: David Horowitz
subject: the enemy within
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zria2hc91fsqc1nivhafnvbvl7ifsv8ngrvvo67o_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jm6o74cdh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfggqbgoqlmkbruakfusbddnnm93gq6vub8hiuc8_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jm6o74cdh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz
---
P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I’ll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zv1753feqtoosjj14m94rolasshlhra0p6aempf0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6c1jm6o74cdh2bs)**
