subject: Still waiting on a few of you to take the pledge!
body:
Peter, It’s Thursday and I need you to take the pledge. What pledge am I talking about? The pledge to vote in the June Primary. You may be thinking, ‘well that’s odd...why would I need to pledge to vote in a primary?
| | [ ]()
---
Peter,
---
It’s Thursday and I _need_ you to take the pledge. What pledge am I talking about? The pledge to vote in the June Primary. You may be thinking, ‘well that’s odd...why would I need to pledge to vote in a primary? If I get around to it, I’ll vote. If not, it’s not that big of a deal...’ If you are thinking that, I’m glad you’re reading this email. **On average, only 22% of Common Sense New Jersey voters (folks like you and me) vote in primary elections.** That’s ON AVERAGE, which means sometimes, it’s _even less!_ What happens when WE DON’T VOTE? Other people make the decisions for us. Other people pick who shows up on our November ballots. Who are those “other people”? Usually the establishment, elite, status-quo types that we’re so sick and tired of running New Jersey. So it is absolutely _ESSENTIAL_ that you vote in the June primary (**it’s June 10th, btw**) and the pledge helps us confirm if you will be voting or if we need to keep chasing, and reminding and persuading you.
---
[ I'll take the pledge right now ](https://xtz223.keap-link012.com/v2/click/bf8d0aec8a23514fb9ac4d81ac9dcf0b/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnMXNj768RYiI5iHqHKIDLenuso6Zhf-9tcJTQdeZ532Gdx5AKHJBcQkB3Ojuuh5YoLHgiqOgrRSUF6-tO_cdz7Gg4uISadkqCB5fwxMwjv3ZemUB9QoNcthvtkmcRac0zhJDqlybG_95lsvF5Al3mziFYfgpxppTeDXuBgLSLY6NSm5a0VFXhj8TqSZgrOs6WwqssGkqrKWwC1kz05cZR64UivLzgAT7t2l4Akm2Y9A=)
---
Who wins when we don’t vote in primaries? Wrapping up our Campaign School and gearing up for the Youth Engagement Fellowship: | | |

Friend, **One way to fight back against the tyrannical president and his billionaire allies is by building the bench of working-class candidates** who will draw from their lived experiences to defend our rights, serve their communities, and demand a government that invests in people’s needs. Each year, my team and I run the Rooted in Community Campaign School to **train progressive community champions who want to be public servants so they can give back to their communities**. Too often money can be a barrier to running for office, so we never charge participants to participate in the training program, which costs $400 per participant to put on. **This month, we just wrapped up our biggest Campaign School yet, with 19 participants.** About two-thirds were women, more than half were Black, and more than a quarter were other people of color—and all are ready to fight for a progressive future in public office. Over five weeks, we brought in current and former elected officials to help train future leaders on fundamentals like how to file the necessary paperwork to run for office, fundraising and campaign finance, running field programs to contact voters, and more. They talked about how they stay rooted in their progressive values and how to end state violence, create more equitable communities, and invest in people’s needs. **Already, two women from the program have filed to run for local office** , and other participants are helping with their electoral campaigns and other local races. **Now, we’re gearing up for another program we run each year to support the next generation of changemakers: our Youth Civic Engagement Fellowship** , which trains mostly BIPOC* young people who are already leaders in their communities on growing their community organizing skills while connecting them with other activists to bring about a more just world. Each participant also receives a stipend for completing the fellowship program. **In the years I’ve served in Congress, it’s been clear that many of my colleagues aren’t fighting with urgency for the bold changes our communities need.** Often it’s because they’re millionaires and they don’t understand how everyday people are struggling to get by. Some legislators vote to boost their stock portfolios at the expense of their constituents.
Now, with Elon Musk—the world’s richest man—taking over our government and stealing from the people, it’s more urgent than ever to have more people in power whose lived experiences help them better understand their communities’ needs. **The American people deserve representatives who are actually in government to represent and serve their communities—like the future leaders who apply for our Campaign School.**
In each session of this year’s Campaign School, current or former elected officials in state and local office joined us to answer questions and talk about how they stay rooted in their communities and in their progressive values. We talked about equity, the need to invest in communities, ending state violence, and standing up to the far-right.
The group from our latest Campaign School is grounding me in hope for the future, with a government that’s actually of, by, and for the people.

clean_body: Wrapping up our Campaign School and gearing up for the Youth Engagement Fellowship: | | | Friend, One way to fight back against the tyrannical president and his billionaire allies is by building the bench of working-class candidates who will draw from their lived experiences to defend our rights, serve their communities, and demand a government that invests in people’s needs. Each year, my team and I run the Rooted in Community Campaign School to train progressive community champions who want to be public servants so they can give back to their communities. Too often money can be a barrier to running for office, so we never charge participants to participate in the training program, which costs $400 per participant to put on. This month, we just wrapped up our biggest Campaign School yet, with 19 participants. About two-thirds were women, more than half were Black, and more than a quarter were other people of color—and all are ready to fight for a progressive future in public office. Over five weeks, we brought in current and former elected officials to help train future leaders on fundamentals like how to file the necessary paperwork to run for office, fundraising and campaign finance, running field programs to contact voters, and more. They talked about how they stay rooted in their progressive values and how to end state violence, create more equitable communities, and invest in people’s needs. Already, two women from the program have filed to run for local office , and other participants are helping with their electoral campaigns and other local races. Now, we’re gearing up for another program we run each year to support the next generation of changemakers: our Youth Civic Engagement Fellowship , which trains mostly BIPOC young people who are already leaders in their communities on growing their community organizing skills while connecting them with other activists to bring about a more just world. Each participant also receives a stipend for completing the fellowship program. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | In the years I’ve served in Congress, it’s been clear that many of my colleagues aren’t fighting with urgency for the bold changes our communities need. Often it’s because they’re millionaires and they don’t understand how everyday people are struggling to get by. Some legislators vote to boost their stock portfolios at the expense of their constituents. Now, with Elon Musk—the world’s richest man—taking over our government and stealing from the people, it’s more urgent than ever to have more people in power whose lived experiences help them better understand their communities’ needs. The American people deserve representatives who are actually in government to represent and serve their communities—like the future leaders who apply for our Campaign School. In each session of this year’s Campaign School, current or former elected officials in state and local office joined us to answer questions and talk about how they stay rooted in their communities and in their progressive values. We talked about equity, the need to invest in communities, ending state violence, and standing up to the far-right. The group from our latest Campaign School is grounding me in hope for the future, with a government that’s actually of, by, and for the people. We will keep fighting back together, inside and outside of the halls of power. In solidarity, Rashida BIPOC means Black, Indigenous, and people of color \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Wed, Mar 26, 2025 Subject: Training progressive candidates to fight fascism and serve their communities To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, When I was first elected to Congress in 2018, I came in as part of a historic wave of women of color with various faith and economic backgrounds that have been under-represented in our government for too long. Since then, billionaires have grown their influence over our government. Many government officials are millionaires or billionaires and don’t understand the needs of the communities they’re supposed to serve. Too many are delaying much-needed changes like universal healthcare and a universal basic income, while cutting funding for essential programs like Social Security, Medicaid, and SNAP nutrition benefits. They’re also taking away the constitutional rights of vulnerable communities. One way to fight back against growing fascism is by urgently building the bench of progressive candidates —especially candidates with the lived experiences needed to represent and protect their marginalized and lower-income constituents. This Women’s History Month,we wrapped up our** free2025 Campaign School with our biggest cohort yet : 19 people, two-thirds of whom were women. More than half of the participants in this year’s Campaign School were Black, and more than a quarter of the participants were Asian, Latinx, or Arab. Already, two women who participated have filed to run for local office , and others are helping with local campaigns. Over five weekly sessions, we covered fundamentals for running a grassroots campaign, including filing for office, fundraising for electoral campaigns, running field operations to connect with voters, recruiting volunteers, and getting endorsements. We brought in current and former elected officials who are rooted in their communities and standing up for human rights. This year, we received a record number of applicants. Thanks to your support, our Campaign School was completely free to attend for each participant. Now we’re gearing up for our 2025 Youth Civic Engagement Fellowship to train young—primarily BIPOC—activists and leaders in community organizing, including stipends for participants. Dear friends, readers, and supporters,
At the moment, I am navigating a deeply personal life event involving my father's health. As my family and I are his primary caregivers, it is of utmost importance that we allocate as much of our time and effort as possible to his care in the time we have left with him.
As such, rather than my daily posts, expect to see fewer posts over the coming near future. Life is impossible to predict, so my apologies I cannot be more precise.
It is not lost on me, that because of your trust and support, I am fortunate to be able to spend this precious time with him. A privilege of time afforded to too few, and one that should be a human right for all. As I reflect on the deplorable state of access to care in this nation, this lived experience is reminding me once more how much work we must do to demand the humanity and dignity of our aging generations.
Thank you for your continued trust in my work. I remain deeply grateful to each of you. Thank you for your support throughout, and your patience and compassion during this time. I ask for your continued grace as I manage this situation with my family. Your support means more than I can express, and I look forward to returning to this work--with renewed strength and on the front lines with you--as soon as life allows.
I will post human rights content as I can, and life updates when possible. If you pray, we welcome your prayers.
With peace and gratitude,
Qasim

What do Forwardists think about US responses to the Environment?

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_56_environment_fo&n=1)

Thursday, March 27, 2025 | Peter -- Welcome back to our _**Controlling What You Can**_ series. Last week's topic was the environment. This area has a lot of depth to it, so we'll surely be digging in deeper into individual areas in future installments of the series, but we started with some high-level questions. Here were your thoughts: The vast majority of Forwardists are at least somewhat dissatisfied with how the US is doing on environmental issues, and a significant plurality are very dissatisfied. In short, we're not being good stewards for future generations. There was a broad agreement in the comments you all submitted that the government ** _can and must_ do a better job**—that we have a moral imperative to safeguard the environment to ensure that younger generations will still have a world like the one we grew up in. Two primary threads emerged in the comments and poll:
1. **Focusing on renewable energy and clean water dominated the polling, with clean water taking the edge between the two**

* Nearly 48% of you believe that focusing on clean water should be a top priority, and nearly 40% believe the focus should be on renewable energy.

* In the comments, many of you expressed frustration at the political forces that have led us away from directly tackling these two issues, highlighting the need for a Party and candidates that are trying to solve these problems for Americans rather than listening only to their donors.

2. **You called for real change —for visionary action**

* Nearly all of you want the US to be leaders globally in the clean energy revolution.

* You expressed desire for transformative policies over incremental change and called for leadership that inspires global cooperation towards a solution.

Because of each of you, _**Controlling What You Can**_ has become one of our most engaging series, so we plan to continue it well into the future! Please let us know what topics you think we should cover next. The Forward Party is building a new home for the politically homeless, and this is our first step in giving a voice to the politically voiceless _._ Thank you all for participating. This will help our candidates know what policies Forwardists will support on their platforms - **and it's starting where it should: with _you_**.

subject: Taking Power Back at the Local Level – A Message from Our Executive Director

body:
| | |
At Local Democracy Project, we’re launching a down-ballot revolution by supporting municipal races and community organizations—reclaiming local power through genuine, face-to-face engagement.
We’re honored to partner with: [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsCgbBF5rm9TF3OCm2PlAzc830mH0SaEU79yenHkofnNxmYVU0KaNelsGDLQBgZYnw_TLU4ud3LTKaTO7PuapHWBtSwDuHOU_1PJDmfavtIPoAj9SX3Xe5Jxna_kMEvd5MZSU7WkFkO8kxYXA-e5cyEPqIQez4Sjivd3NssvmSM-xWHk5MXxw4k-0EkQYnfZu9IpmIqX3L-ttylg4ARnAh1D_SfLH9xEeutjV0whUWXPVYfWIQO9XUVDlloLwZMwmuCqzn3n1gtTQu2AD5Mk03BvXCfTBFg1wwwh_MWHjBFiaU1RlsdsMaFjfsaQWSi9GwVCK_HSIcxwd6_Bu41V_cyG47oRkcQkJGTj63ppJuNFlSjtisgwkdXX5QTeMqNqxU_wPI6wNaiBuc5Cf0aReUMF9_le8JG9JkbuCaYpYELMYKxxxEiS662ZDM52pYqks0/4f5/QR-kHgtESwyrL5jsruQCSQ/h0/h001.ugOStgms40gL4OVzUNtjIFaMYkQv7WRnLY5cjeklbZ0)
This work is deeply personal –
**For four years, I ran for Congress in a district the establishment labeled “unwinnable.”** I didn’t choose an easier, safe race—I ran because I saw a community left behind.
Over two election cycles, I witnessed a bigger truth: the Democratic Party is no longer the party of the working class.
While everyday people struggled, Democrats poured millions into consultants who never stepped into our neighborhoods.
Meanwhile, Republicans knocked on doors, registered voters, and built local power by winning school boards, city councils, and county seats.
I remember a union worker in Barstow telling me, “I don’t trust Democrats. They talk a big game, but my paycheck hasn’t grown, and my bills keep piling up.” He was right.
That moment shifted my perspective. Instead of focusing solely on winning a congressional seat, I began talking about building something lasting—empowering communities at the grassroots level.
**At Local Democracy Project, we invest in down-ballot races to elect real working-class leaders—people who live the struggle and deliver change.**
****A presidential candidate can’t shake hands with millions, but thousands of local candidates can.
They meet their neighbors, listen to their struggles, and fight for them—not for corporate donors.
_That’s how we win._
**__We’re not waiting for change from the top— We’re organizing. We’re taking power back at the local level.**

clean_body: | | | At Local Democracy Project, we’re launching a down-ballot revolution by supporting municipal races and community organizations—reclaiming local power through genuine, face-to-face engagement. We’re honored to partner with: This work is deeply personal – For four years, I ran for Congress in a district the establishment labeled “unwinnable.” I didn’t choose an easier, safe race—I ran because I saw a community left behind. Over two election cycles, I witnessed a bigger truth: the Democratic Party is no longer the party of the working class. While everyday people struggled, Democrats poured millions into consultants who never stepped into our neighborhoods. Meanwhile, Republicans knocked on doors, registered voters, and built local power by winning school boards, city councils, and county seats. I remember a union worker in Barstow telling me, “I don’t trust Democrats. They talk a big game, but my paycheck hasn’t grown, and my bills keep piling up.” He was right. That moment shifted my perspective. Instead of focusing solely on winning a congressional seat, I began talking about building something lasting—empowering communities at the grassroots level. At Local Democracy Project, we invest in down-ballot races to elect real working-class leaders—people who live the struggle and deliver change. **A presidential candidate can’t shake hands with millions, but thousands of local candidates can. They meet their neighbors, listen to their struggles, and fight for them—not for corporate donors. That’s how we win. We’re not waiting for change from the top— We’re organizing. We’re taking power back at the local level.** Thank you for standing with us. \- Derek Marshall, Executive Director, Local Democracy Project supports down-ballot races and empowering communities across the country. I've always believed that if you want to go fast, go alone. But if you want to go far, go together. That belief is what drew me to activism more than 50 years ago, and it’s what keeps me going today. Because no one wins these fights alone. I’ve marched, I’ve protested, and I’ve been arrested. I’ve sat across from people in power and demanded change. And after all these years, I can say without a doubt that there has never been a more urgent moment than this. The window to prevent climate catastrophe is closing fast, and Trump and Big Oil are stepping on the gas. They’re auctioning off our environment to the highest bidder so they can line their pockets. Their unchecked greed is poisoning our communities and fueling a public health crisis while driving up rates of illnesses like asthma and cancer. But I refuse to sit back and let them destroy everything we love. That’s why I started JanePAC: to elect leaders who will fight for bold climate action and put people before polluters. We don’t have their billions of dollars, but we have something stronger. We have a grassroots movement that refuses to back down. clean_body: Because our future depends on it. | I've always believed that if you want to go fast, go alone. But if you want to go far, go together. That belief is what drew me to activism more than 50 years ago, and it’s what keeps me going today. Because no one wins these fights alone. I’ve marched, I’ve protested, and I’ve been arrested. I’ve sat across from people in power and demanded change. And after all these years, I can say without a doubt that there has never been a more urgent moment than this. The window to prevent climate catastrophe is closing fast, and Trump and Big Oil are stepping on the gas. They’re auctioning off our environment to the highest bidder so they can line their pockets. Their unchecked greed is poisoning our communities and fueling a public health crisis while driving up rates of illnesses like asthma and cancer. But I refuse to sit back and let them destroy everything we love. That’s why I started JanePAC: to elect leaders who will fight for bold climate action and put people before polluters. We don’t have their billions of dollars, but we have something stronger. We have a grassroots movement that refuses to back down. And right now, this movement needs you. body:
He stands up to protect Virginians every single day and is an exceptional Attorney General who we must re-elect.| | | Friend, Will you join me today in supporting someone who vigorously defends the laws of the Commonwealth, who stands with law enforcement every single day while leading our shared fight to end the free flow of opioids and fentanyl into our communities, and who has been a constant advocate for victims of human trafficking and domestic violence? _**I’m talking about Attorney General Jason Miyares. **_ He stands up to protect Virginians every single day and is an exceptional Attorney General who we must re-elect. Virginians made their voices heard in 2021, and the Attorney General and I went straight to work. Since then, we have prioritized jumpstarting job growth, empowering parents, keeping our communities safe, making government work for Virginians, ensuring free speech while defending against antisemitism, as well as protecting the vulnerable against human trafficking and sexual exploitation. The extreme left is prioritizing Virginia and Jason in efforts to anoint liberal Attorney Generals who will be soft on crime, ignore dangerous, criminal, illegal immigrants in our communities, and consider the rights of criminals over the rights of victims and their families. We can't let that happen in our Commonwealth. When millions pour in from out-of-state, out-of-touch interests to take back the Attorney General’s office, we need to be prepared with energy and resources to win this race in November. That’s why I need you to join me in supporting Jason’s campaign today. All of America’s eyes are laser focused on Virginia in 2025. Those of us passionate about Virginia are working to keep her moving forward on a path of excellence, prosperity, safety and commonsense governance. With Jason continuing as our Attorney General, we can remain secure in our future! Please join me in supporting and donating to Jason’s campaign for Attorney General today. He has a critical March 31st campaign finance deadline and your support now is critical. **[Will you join me in giving today?](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/s/c/IQAw2jL1cd3Os5YgG-wOrdhmcqfkFhY_ZLE2pLMFKRfleZ3BKPk-o1v94ZZwgTmD3Xj-X1LYCzzhC8S3Bi_n-ecP_uOb0pEHL8Gli86ANcDTyXwYCOlnhbqh9sCbcbygxbw_2UbNkymN41x6ntzVCYNOZByfR-nshUWWoMABCYT0MGZrkgyG50udEBiYoyfqH9SJMw1RPHmumOnCVAiR_kkjWgn1ACF8lC2F8XrvGA4MM7SQWevpYDqdtX3gUmwHTW-oxv_Anut9F2qKNaBTnUuNbwYnencllV5nD1rAdK24yJjeaMZTG9ZPX7BPIJPcI6Ne_4oad7fv1gw8p4qWPQMcKJ7lFtVgFRo1QrC487Dlpv2j2LIQFgWZfkU/06ewev69SPQQzFeiWh7i9axWXZm753sz/7)** Sincerely, Governor Glenn Youngkin **P.S.**_There is no one I’d rather have standing with me as our Attorney General these last three years than Jason Miyares. subject: Trump Pardons J6ers… Now what?
body:
First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

| | |
---
| | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/mYF7UO0J7OVUWYCuqQK9LD5O2-mZXPtpLHvWRHtRZ54n5ovXZR_TAYuT_gDBlb430y3hxlVEli3n8YUKPLMxBvM87i8si3Px559evQ5UzPOKYNp6fm0_GrwYiJj015f8ASRCxqcEUIAnQYjwbXVMjKGmVaF_O6OwsAjXsB-KBMnPT_YAJ3U6OQo3NaqswIGfQrV0zWAKybTZ8TbFNgJIWp9M8Z8ji4aWHRwBIRY-SqmfizfTXt2x2j0t4eUs0Rqqq93eoGItZ_QbQy_i3I2c6FduKTcSCUKD-RpoY2cBxOu0AnDlVdzcDS1hgDbVFAEPXPCrQ8mTSHpLIxqugICsva-KFVsI/GngdAJR-W0N4vBUdOcpLwZ5vcbja0CnZ/7) Friend,

First, let me start by saying this: Thank God for President Trump and his pardoning of J6 prisoners.

Even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers...

**I work directly with many of the J6ers. And here are some of the issues they face: Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. And many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life.**

They have had their rights stripped from them. Many have been separated from their families for years. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm.

Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions.

_And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights._

So, what comes next for J6ers?

There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That’s exactly what Stand in the Gap is helping them do.

[Friend, as a personal favor to me, can you please send an urgent donation of $10 or more to support Stand in the Gap? I am hoping to get 100 new supporters to help us in our mission to rebuild the lives of J6ers who need us now more than ever.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/5jKkbD8ioiAGZRgBj6MwKZ-WdQ8m2QtWFXIAdCo_NxZZfvTqzeqWCArDjRx-Lr0HxaCWzPKVDzUuCwX1K6NbHNIjVT0cOVoL7HVEI5NzxLaNJnKGDabhG2SjOZ9fnV1GH8aPnpP4OLg9TxsDXeln14niM5m6lT3-KS-EOAlAIwAqCCCX7u_t4R8r6jOAinM0N03V6kCpl5yM83NT2mXPJy6GVYn4tn4QB8Ffvogae5nbwzJQWzvGKPyF_zwIMAlss6ToxW8H5t28KSHGqZppWVEEbSUvu82qTGvEhQTpG02DDeVg6_3LG_x427tEmbKFieER1JpDjbwLbgQdR8L8B4U8oPRZ/aaXRU83-vlZqMJnuf2e3bGtA1tsccwlq/7)
[Donate](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/pzjK7fx1qDFFi_M_nLQ5BSqVnXBtvfmE9G8tcvLuA_9AQDCm65RLFzoSocL66wX1Z_v34OuCEtA4HJc_8AAHOmZbLekYq9RhaBwvn-6YerqMj7GWRKPg0_KRdIslC5I2brl7Kzk7zrjWTQQX2W5Gbi9L4hujLNIJ7sGkVuYXj-jSkBUcjo4ktENILqSz0oDJKhz8yAQVlZre6RABdet5537Km7ws0D6MuRHnZQ7HrUjypkv_wKTN3G-fxWcnmGupBh-Gf96c66NFZMCe19fbWRIFUdMWLEiPjn4Wp9NWpTKi4wxNnYre_oOGeCs6OlRvEnvhZoVnbawKM4SXquH7ClmKt77t/XN4p8GEEOCd_b24p78ZymO2_nTOvckI-/7)
Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated.

One of the simplest ways we are helping them is by providing them with insurance and the resources to meet their healthcare needs.

Many of the J6ers haven’t seen a dentist or doctor in four years. They’ve lost their jobs, which means they’ve lost their insurance.

Our mission is to ensure that every J6er not only has access to healthcare to meet all of their medical needs but also receives the help they need to heal mentally, emotionally, and financially.

[Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, $100, or any amount you can generously afford today. >>](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/vdILsJ8jjq87AasfNT80ycoG36EIcbVOg_hDHUP8NusvAKkwiF-FFo4OJNxDaSTJVFl0YSk0EdYUwJ85zdkyzwSFwuhXG6GeaAslji6_HVvpOYZJwj2n7adhxrzRwkkfS5NPQCAgYyXQNC3qE-4FGmE8D6doKOmkUtq1YcdO_zC7OgCA9ZLDP1mcczacoTunKKr70zDAuRu3Fzii-S2egkmBqikNq2SzVwCNrlsrpjJ3GopMrZYn3nSoCqjjaZRbBeBmNLqL7Oq9PGxN_zChwD0uIj-rkDjPZT-YOrBmsjmDEOiI50H-ekqzbG8i9fyyc1uSe4pN2rdXs1w2OZ64svs0FV1q/Gmf4yalSCHJkOCdK1TqLcgSdl-oFsuj9/7)
[Donate](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/jne5bPGX9wQK--KHTt8bJhCxdYqGDwm6b2XHA2PEthNzDTG6LzAmjStT8KmKUlQWuICuBLMBhtSmJlelXnKDngrds9qMJz43Bfr0yfoJNxYGcohFUVwKtZn4YIcSnL6lWhDZZtec3yAgE5LwyrZin4sVvtwno_r5ePB0ayVmumWOrJdDYtLOmElCJ3V_Sp4fDF8v5oJdhkCPXa0-RdDHVTPQjELqp3jAUdavYP1fDh2khggmhIGcrIc3u6lijgabB2kfQ91JCmCSn9vV1sYxMTrRdd2DoJOYeUm7W7S07U-WMfo_htTI-Je0CWRkyJZpnf54dfiKDype_NmjlMm-RR4Rtymy/US6XSt9n-vsf4AnYh5S3DTDWHUpxXpdE/7)
Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not.

We were founded to “stand in the gap” for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. Our primary aim is to let them know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing health insurance to meet immediate physical needs and evolves as Stand In The Gap is the one-stop shop for any J6er in need of counseling as they reintegrate back into society.

The J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers, and It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity.

[If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand In The Gap provide healthcare and counseling to our J6 community.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/qJAz5WbyZ2bMjDsgm2uMJ37fTVaN6pXW3w2MuV9qqobUAp9L-DiQGl0fSaxgQp9hLK1mRy7WDYIbCxAx0oPtqGC-O3qXeg1e0ALrxLJ8e21MIhGJ5TzuahxHMTnVgSYu1lKWGpJlCZs5e5JZ__xJVxnzjSyDtA_KgEhDXady9hqwdNHz0w4fs_P9YufvVlO31uz5sNuj_TEN5tk3ZYxz1iC0Jxd_O-occ0FwYiVY5BhV8iv9lCnxozvAfmUIkcLeX5Zn_cK1got0-Z05-6VbAXCHmZiHKG5Q6slJQAIkIgRlug7AZWdWoa4GB5vxDsEXW5dOukbNRwpyg3PuGhYnASggzo3d/P8pURfXd8O9pLGk6qOFPN59RRWJf0Y31/7)

Sincerely,

Sarah McAbee
Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer, Stand in the Gap

Even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers... I work directly with many of the J6ers. And here are some of the issues they face: Some are homeless to this day. Some can’t get a job because of the time they’ve spent in jail. And many are struggling to return to some semblance of a normal life. They have had their rights stripped from them. Many have been separated from their families for years. They can’t vote. They can’t own a firearm. Not only are these men and women patriots, but they come from all walks of life — law enforcement, veterans, white-collar professionals, blue-collar workers, and all races and religions. And they were hunted down in a political persecution that denied them their constitutional rights. So, what comes next for J6ers? There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives. That’s exactly what Stand in the Gap is helping them do. Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated. One of the simplest ways we are helping them is by providing them with insurance and the resources to meet their healthcare needs. Many of the J6ers haven’t seen a dentist or doctor in four years. They’ve lost their jobs, which means they’ve lost their insurance. Our mission is to ensure that every J6er not only has access to healthcare to meet all of their medical needs but also receives the help they need to heal mentally, emotionally, and financially. Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative or America First activists. While some J6ers come from families with means, most do not. We were founded to “stand in the gap” for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. Our primary aim is to let them know that they are not forgotten. This begins by providing health insurance to meet immediate physical needs and evolves as Stand In The Gap is the one-stop shop for any J6er in need of counseling as they reintegrate back into society. The J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers, and It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity. | | 20,057 newly registered votersso far this year are receiving welcome postcards in the mail! Rural Americans United did not stop, because you did not stop. Together there is nothing we can’t do!
---
| | | |
---
| | 'Nothing Worth Having Was Ever Achieved Without Effort.'Theodore Roosevelt
A thunderous roar is rising from the people, even as we face historically low confidence in the national Democratic leadership ([CNN](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=2zO8eJqsP99g2OVg7AXOv8IrIDfI_BJn4aAFeCcGUC4.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY25uLmNvbS8yMDI1LzAzLzE2L3BvbGl0aWNzL2Nubi1wb2xsLWRlbW9jcmF0cy9pbmRleC5odG1sIiwiciI6ImQwNGM4ZTZhLWM4MGEtNDBjOC04NzdmLTI4MDk4NjQ1NTAzYiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)). Why? Because we are strong, we are rural America. Nobody works harder or cares more about our family, neighbors, and country than we do. We have less, give more, and ask for little. We are the first in line to offer help and the last in line to receive it. We are strong. From Okanogan to Klickitat and from Chelan to Spokane counties, we are on the streets, writing letters, making phone calls, holding workshops, and working with our local elected leaders to do more.
---
| |
---
| | Tri-Cities Indivisible Town Hall Session 1 March 23, 2025
---
| | Every day, I felt the waning hope of Democrats in Central and Eastern Washington, it was palpable. But in just a few short weeks of 47’s term, I hear and see an uprising like never before. People who once would not have lifted their sad butts off the couch are now lining the streets with placards, demonstrating their power. Where twenty attendees once constituted a great showing at a political event, we are now seeing hundreds. Recently, in the small community of the Methow, several hundred showed up for a [missing Dan Newhouse town hall](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=nW7YqC6OtiEPNeSFmjHpZ_Nz1tabc7SXkWC4cA0oHKQ.). In the Tri Cities, an [Indivisible group](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=dX8mhrcAczHP50PeBZD8hTcdcfAUGminYmEqch9BrnQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL3Byb2ZpbGUucGhwP2lkPTYxNTc0MTk2NjA1Nzg1IiwiciI6Ijg3YWQ4ZDQ4LTY4NGYtNDIxNC1hZDhmLTVlZDJiYjdiMTVkMyIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) so new that their Facebook page had only four posts organized a town hall that grew so large they needed two sessions. In Spokane, a newly elected, extremely naive and arrogant MAGA, Mike Baumgartner, was crucified by a [massive turnout](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=9c3eeB5NmVu9QvjG9xTdKQ3ig0cyTKOSMZ8GbQzwAR0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1aUFdkajBxT3I4QSIsInIiOiI4N2FkOGQ0OC02ODRmLTQyMTQtYWQ4Zi01ZWQyYmI3YjE1ZDMiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) of well prepared and angry constituents. Here in Yakima, where local Democrats have long struggled to get enough people to form a quorum, a new group is emerging. At its first meeting, eighty nine people showed up, and more are signing up for the next. Wonderful organizations like [Ella](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=IC6du6Qdvzp3Tz25wiQqlidpjebxLlEGNcibgEFT2cs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93ZWFyZWVsbGEub3JnLyIsInIiOiI4N2FkOGQ0OC02ODRmLTQyMTQtYWQ4Zi01ZWQyYmI3YjE1ZDMiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) and [YIRN](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=yYP71akcyTq7aCfF6qjgty1ieLqHRbiYBWcd3-IAMFw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL1lha2ltYUltbWlncmFudFJlc3BvbnNlTmV0d29yayIsInIiOiI4N2FkOGQ0OC02ODRmLTQyMTQtYWQ4Zi01ZWQyYmI3YjE1ZDMiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) are holding workshops to educate us and our neighbors on how best to defend ourselves against the very real and personal threats being made against us by 47.
---
| |
---
| | One in ten people in Yakima County are at risk to ICE actions.Immigration, Social Security, Medicaid, federal worker firings, farm programs, and SNAP are all under attack by 47. These programs are essential to keeping our communities safe and economically stable. Yet we have representatives who neither know us nor care, CD 4’s Do Nothing Dan Newhouse and now Mike Baumgartner in Congressional District 5. Patty Murray is a strong senator, and we are fortunate to have her, but her focus remains on Hanford, where the big money rolls in. She has never given sufficient attention to the vast majority in this district who make their living from agriculture or lower paying manufacturing jobs. Now is the time for our elected officials to hear all of us! [It only takes 3.5%](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=WTpdHO2B7rWrdYnCw2UE5z-W-X96SMbJuVWrc-So75A.) You can face the future in two ways. You can internalize your fear and hope it passes with minimal pain, or you can find pride in yourself and your country and rise up. This is NOT the time to be a Schumer, now is the time to be an AOC or a [Bernie](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=cQ_FzyMtWlCJh9jdHztW6QyqM3ufeUVrusPjcd58Qfk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubnByLm9yZy8yMDI1LzAzLzIyL254LXMxLTUzMzQ0ODgvYmVybmllLXNhbmRlcnMtZmlnaHQtb2xpZ2FyY2h5LXRvdXItdHJ1bXAtbXVzay1kb2dlLWRlbW9jcmF0cyIsInIiOiJjZjAyOThhNi02YWVkLTQ1ZDctYmU0MS0yMWM3MDA0YzVmMDgiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ). There will not be a better time or another opportunity. As Rep. [Celeste Maloy](https://ruralamericansunited.org/so/f6PNOaFgr/c?w=boMoOWBsqeVxgop1u8Qn1aDwPqqslrYa6OzA649pnNU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly90aGVoaWxsLmNvbS9ob21lbmV3cy81MjA3MTU1LWNlbGVzdGUtbWFsb3ktZXhlY3V0aXZlLWJyYW5jaC1hdXRob3JpdGFyaWFuaXNtLyIsInIiOiJjZjAyOThhNi02YWVkLTQ1ZDctYmU0MS0yMWM3MDA0YzVmMDgiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) (R Utah) warned, “I am concerned about the country careening toward authoritarianism if we don’t get the executive branch under control.”

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s5v079c7b57)**
| | Hey everyone,
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Three [major gun-control bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sai1ed53eae) are just steps from the governor’s desk, including a sweeping ban on many firearms with detachable magazines. Meanwhile, [HB25-1220](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/scv359f11d4), which would license dietitians, is facing backlash from holistic health advocates who say it threatens medical freedom and favors corporate interests.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Douglas County commissioners voted to [pursue home rule](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sfsf0bdcd1d) in a push for greater autonomy from what they call reckless state policies, while the City of Rifle is demanding answers over the state’s diversion of [severance tax funds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s1s068e3833) meant for local infrastructure—warning it could jeopardize critical projects.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** President Trump signed an executive order requiring documentary proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections, prompting [fierce backlash from Colorado officials](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s0pe7214ad4) who call it voter suppression. The White House also directed a federal agency to review how states [maintain voter rolls](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sald936f23b), raising legal and constitutional concerns from local election leaders.

🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Congressman Gabe Evans is under fire from progressives for [declining a town hall invite](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sape796cc27), which critics framed as a refusal of accountability—but columnist Michael Hancock says it was a stand against performative outrage politics.

This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 27, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Holistic health practitioners fight back against HB25-1220’s threat to medical freedom](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s1pc729eefc)** BY TORI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s6g9e73a467)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s1s93c5f8e8)
A new bill moving through the Colorado General Assembly, HB25-1220, is drawing sharp criticism from holistic health practitioners and nutritionists, who argue it amounts to government overreach that could criminalize alternative health practices and limit consumer choice.
Proponents say the bill is necessary to protect public health by ensuring only qualified professionals provide medical nutrition therapy (MNT).
The legislation would create the State Board of Dietetics and Nutrition, with the authority to license, regulate, and discipline professionals practicing medical nutrition therapy. Under the bill, individuals offering nutrition services must obtain a state license by September 1, 2026, or face penalties, including a class two misdemeanor, fines starting at $750, and up to 120 days in jail.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s9kf5817cf8)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sct33dfb06a)
|

**[Hancock: Progressives set the stage, but Congressman Evans skipped the guillotine](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s3j2647b9c2)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sbi28669bc4)
* In a fiery commentary, Michael Hancock defends Congressman Gabe Evans for skipping a town hall organized by progressive activists, calling it a political trap designed for public shaming rather than genuine dialogue.
* Hancock argues that the event was less about civic engagement and more about forcing ideological conformity, criticizing the left’s tendency to equate disagreement with moral failure.
* He warns that performative outrage is replacing democratic debate, urging progressives to pursue persuasion and elections—not spectacles and cancel culture.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/seuf0b6e0ec)**
|
---
**[Major gun-control proposals close in on passage in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s5v1553934f)** [NPR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/segeca3f816)
* Three major gun-control bills are nearing final passage in Colorado, including a sweeping ban on firearms with detachable magazines, set to take effect in August 2026.
* Additional measures would raise the minimum age to buy ammunition to 21 and tighten regulations on gun shows, requiring added security, liability insurance, and adherence to the state’s waiting period law.
* Republicans strongly oppose the bills, calling them unconstitutional and harmful to law-abiding gun owners, while gun-rights groups are already preparing legal challenges.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sfl73672be8)**
|
---
**[Trump order sparks backlash from Colorado election officials over proof of citizenship rule](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s6nd0ae2fb4)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/scnf9f0e26a)
* President Trump’s executive order requiring proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections aims to strengthen election integrity and prevent non-citizen voting.
* Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold called the order a “poll tax,” saying the order would disproportionately affect low-income Americans, people of color, and women—particularly those without updated identification documents.
* She warned the order could disenfranchise voters and is based on unfounded claims about non-citizens voting, which is already illegal in Colorado.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sdkeec19569)**
|
---
**[City of Rifle blasts state for misusing severance tax dollars](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sci7504b1c4)** [POST INDEPENDENT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s3h99cc9b93)
* The City of Rifle is sending a formal letter to state legislators protesting the diversion of Local Government Severance Tax Funds, which were originally intended to support communities impacted by energy extraction.
* City officials say the state is misusing these funds to cover general budget shortfalls, jeopardizing essential projects like water infrastructure and street repairs.
* Rifle leaders argue the practice violates the law’s intent and disproportionately harms small, energy-producing towns already dealing with the economic consequences of boom-and-bust cycles.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s5h65a5d6df)**
|

**[Did Grand Junction’s City Council enable a pay-to-play deal?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s7i4e67ef4a)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s2ob0e4d75a)****BY JEN SCHUMANN****| LOCAL | MARCH 25** _When the City of Grand Junction accepted a $3 million donation from Intermountain Health (St. Mary’s Hospital) in exchange for naming rights to its new Community Recreation Center (CRC), the deal looked like a win for the community._
__
**[Tristan: Democrats are betting on fear to win back power](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sbt26fe32eb)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/s2m16283551)****BY GEORGE TRISTAN | COMMENTARY | MARCH 25** _Nearly all the plexiglass barriers have been removed from checkout lines in grocery stores. It is rare to find any of the 6-foot spaced markers that facilitated social distancing. And thankfully, toilet paper is back in full supply on store shelves. However, the fear of COVID lives on. Many people still wear masks – some even don gloves._
__
**[Profit or patients? The 340B fight that could close Colorado hospitals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sbo35d37f56)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-WLRQ/sfn0a914166)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 24** _If Senate Bill 25-071 fails, Julie Lonborg says her neighbor could end up driving from Lone Tree to Thornton just to pick up a single prescription. That’s not some theoretical what-if._
__

body:
Yesterday, our movement had a big win at the Supreme Court.
#

Huge news: Yesterday, our movement had a big win at the Supreme Court.
The Court ruled 7-2 to uphold ATF’s critical ghost gun rule.
Their ruling affirmed that ghost gun kits are legally firearms, meaning they must have serial numbers and can only be sold by licensed sellers after a background check.
Ghost guns have been the gun industry’s way of skirting commonsense gun laws and arming dangerous people without background checks.
These weapons are highly attractive to firearm traffickers precisely because there are no background checks or sale records and the guns themselves are untraceable.
This win is big for public safety -- especially with a 7-2 decision from the conservative Supreme Court.
With your support, our team has been at the forefront of the fight against ghost guns. We’ve fought back in the courts. We’ve advocated for stronger state and federal laws. We’ve sued the largest ghost gun supplier in the nation -- and won.
None of that is possible with you and the rest of this grassroots movement.

body:
I’m fighting to bring more service-driven leadership to Washington, D.C., but I need your support.

| | | [](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM2JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MDMyN181TC1DQi4xMTAxMTdfdDE2MTg4MTEtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTAzMjdfNUwtQ0IuMTEwMTE3X3QxNjE4ODExLTI4OTkifQ/K1KvnoVEi-2pAOulGgrjaw)

That’s me in the red circle ^^^

I served in the USAF/ANG for 8 years in the Combat Search and Rescue Squadron (CSAR), conducting search and recovery missions in the Middle East. Every last man and woman I served alongside was there because they loved their country.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM2JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MDMyN181TC1DQi4xMTAxMTdfdDE2MTg4MTEtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTAzMjdfNUwtQ0IuMTEwMTE3X3QxNjE4ODExLTI4OTkifQ/a41QSRuC_hObJ2ZHdQ-4Sw)

Now I’m in Congress, and I hate to say it, but the stereotypes are true—most politicians are self-absorbed, materialistic, and unwilling to sacrifice for their country.

Fortunately, the tide is turning, and more Patriots are being elected. It’s no secret that we need more **leaders who serve rather than be served** , leaders who are willing to put their principles, their integrity, and their country before personal gain.

That’s why I ran for Congress. And that’s why I’m committed to supporting fellow Patriots who are stepping up to lead—not for fame and fortune, but for the future of this great nation.
---

Trump was asked yesterday whether he had been briefed on the four American soldiers missing after a training mission in Lithuania, several hours after the incident. At the time we wrote this email, those four soldiers are still missing.
#
Trump was asked yesterday whether he had been briefed on the four American soldiers missing after a training mission in Lithuania, several hours after the incident. At the time we wrote this email, those four soldiers are still missing.
He responded: “No, I haven't.” And then he moved on. The Commander in Chief had not been briefed by his staff — and he did not care.
This happened a day after he told the press he was unaware of an absolutely massive security failure in his defense and intelligence chain of command, with his own appointees at fault.
While shadow president Elon Musk is gutting critical care and services at the VA and threatening to fire 83,000 more after already kicking thousands of VA staff out of their jobs — alongside thousands of other Veterans serving in government jobs.
From the man who trampled the graves of our fallen in Arlington National Cemetery for a photo op.
The man who refused to honor the fallen at an American cemetery in France because of some rain.
Who refused to be seen with wounded Veterans because, “it doesn't look good for me.”
Who attacked Gold Star Parents multiple times.
Who called the fallen “suckers” and “losers.”
Donald Trump does not care about the Military. He does not care about the millions of Veterans who depend on the VA, Medicaid, or Social Security. Elon Musk is destroying vital services for Veterans. Republicans in Congress are enabling both of them, and abandoning their obligations to check Trump's power.
We will not let any of this go unanswered.
We've already run several targeted campaigns against the GOP in the first two months of the Trump Administration. We run the most effective ads in politics cycle after cycle. We mobilize Veterans to action. And we will give them hell for the next two years, until we win enough seats in Congress to put real checks on Trump and Elon's power. That's a promise.

President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. | | We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections. Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail. Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic. Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ _There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. clean_body: Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail | | | | | | | We're going to keep hammering this home, Team,** because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever. President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail. For background:** After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day. So of course, this order directs Attorney General Pam Bondi to “take all necessary action” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day. This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast. If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections. Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail. Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic. Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ” | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. body:
Peter,

As the People’s Lawyer, it’s my responsibility to take action when the Trump administration breaks the law or violates our Constitution. I didn’t run for office so I could sue Donald Trump and his cronies, but I will if that’s what it takes to protect Minnesotans.

I know many of you are worried about how this administration’s chaotic, cruel, and unlawful actions will impact your ability to afford your lives and to live with safety, dignity, and respect. Listening to your concerns and showing you what I’m doing in response is an important part of my job.

That’s why I held a town hall with four of my fellow attorneys general last week. We heard deeply moving stories from veterans fired from jobs they excelled at, trans folks facing discrimination, and teachers watching their schools come under attack.

These powerful stories can serve as evidence in our ongoing lawsuits against the Trump administration. Rest assured that I’ll continue listening to you and doing everything I can to defend our values and the rule of law.

But I can’t do it alone. Your stories help further this fight, but we also need your support. Our campaign is up against a critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline on March 31, and we still need to raise $30,000 to stay on track.

According to our records, you’re still eligible for Minnesota’s Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program. That means you can donate up to $75 (or $150 for couples) and receive a full refund from the State of Minnesota.

Peter, will you make your refundable $75 donation today to help our campaign meet this goal and hold the line?

name: The Editors at Broad + Liberty
subject: Support Journalism That Holds Power Accountable
body:
Support truth in local media with Broad + Liberty | | | | [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5b4a145040&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
| | | Dear Reader:

_Broad + Liberty_ is building a nonprofit media platform for truth-seeking, fearless investigative journalism and opinion. And we’re breaking even more news across the Commonwealth.

As local and national media have increasingly drifted away from truth-seeking in favor of narratives and agendas, **our continued[first reporting](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a6a00ce04e&e=b7b3eddce2) on the sexual harassment scandal of a key aide of Governor Josh Shapiro** is making waves in our state and nationally.

How did one of Gov. Shapiro’s top aides remain in his position for half a year after serious, repeated sexual harassment allegations?

Why did the Administration pay nearly $300,000 in taxpayer dollars to settle the case out of court?

Where were the months' worth of emails that have now gone completely missing after the _Broad + Liberty_ Right to Know Law request?

_**And, most importantly, where are all the other media outlets who are now belatedly picking up the story?**_

You get it. This is why we founded our nonprofit media outlet in 2019, and why you are a reader today. _But have you made a[tax-deductible donation](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e4642a39ae&e=b7b3eddce2) this year to help support this fearless, necessary journalism?_

The fact is that without our dogged investigation, nothing about this story would have seen the light of day. As other media outlets pursue narratives over truth, _Broad + Liberty_ remains committed to the free exchange of ideas, giving voice to the "shut out," and seeking the truth fearlessly — _especially_ when it’s inconvenient to the establishment.

_**We can’t do this without you – which is why we are asking for your support today in the form of a[tax-deductible contribution](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b3502e8fea&e=b7b3eddce2) of any amount.**_

You can make your contribution all the more powerful by choosing to make a monthly, repeating donation. _Broad + Liberty_ needs 1,000 monthly subscribers at $5 a month. Ever heard the expression, “Freedom isn’t free”? It takes resources to perpetuate the ideas of our founding, and we humbly consider ourselves on the front line of that fight.

If you agree that the media must hold our state establishment to account, and support our fearless journalism, please make your best [tax-deductible donation](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=110717f30e&e=b7b3eddce2) today.

Thank you, and onwards!

The Editors at _Broad + Liberty_

Hi Peter,
While Congress was in recess last week, Care in Action supporters ramped up our fight for Medicaid all across the country. At events spanning from California to Virginia, care workers, advocates, and families sent a powerful message, demanding elected officials protect our health care.

body:
It'd mean a lot.
#
Thank you to the record-breaking 86,847 people who joined the Fighting Oligarchy tour this weekend alone, and to the millions who watched and supported online.
This moment is special. **People are standing up, fighting back, and ready to organize**.
I truly don’t do these kinds of emails often (almost never), but the crush of requests to visit many more places across the country requires a lot more resources to take this show on the road!
As many of you know, I do not take a dime in corporate money or from industry lobbyists. **Bernie and I have been able to do ALL of this with small dollar and individual donations from everyday people**. And believe it or not, that’s actually a lot rarer in our politics than you might think.
Anyways - [if you’d consider helping us out with a donation to keep us on the road, it’d mean a lot! Our end of quarter deadline is coming up soon.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250327-1.m5bQYK&refcode=em20250327-8454-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8454%2E2526796%2EOPa6v3)

Alexandria ✌🏽

**_So why does that affect the number of emails we send?_**
Each month I set a fundraising goal, and that number isn’t arbitrary. It’s part of our larger plan to make sure we hit quarterly and even year-long goals.

| | **Leadership Institute Sign-up Email** **The NEGOP is pleased to invite the Leadership Institute to host a[Campaign and Candidate workshop](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=25bbe9beb9&e=25844e23a8) on Saturday, April 12th from 9am-4pm in Lincoln, Nebraska at the [Graduate Hotel: 141 N 9th St, Lincoln, NE 68508](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=997038774b&e=25844e23a8).**
**[](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=d7d532f2d9&e=25844e23a8)****The Campaign and Candidate Workshop is a full-day, hands-on program designed to help you build and run a winning campaign. Ideal attendees are individuals who are looking to become more politically active, candidates running for office, and campaign staff and volunteers who are involved or want to be involved in campaigns at any level. Those who want to hone their skills as a campaign manager and those just wanting to learn the basics of running a political campaign are also encouraged to attend. ** **[Register here](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=48809052d7&e=25844e23a8) for the Campaign and Candidate workshop. Your registration of $15 will include breakfast, lunch, and an afternoon snack. Info related to dietary restriction will be provided soon. ** **The full agenda and class descriptions for the Campaign and Candidate Workshop can be[viewed here. ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=058476973e&e=25844e23a8)** **[What is Leadership Institute?](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=41b42b8d03&e=25844e23a8)
** **Through training and mentorship, the Leadership Institute helps conservatives become successful leaders – from state legislators to members of U.S. Congress, from college students to journalists and heads of organizations – and is unparalleled.** **While many organizations exist to increase the number of leftist activists, few similar organizations exist to serve conservatives. Because conservatism tends to focus on the power of ideas, most conservative organizations are think tanks that focus on policy or legislation.** **But those policies won’t get enacted without conservatives in positions of leadership to drive them forward.** **That’s why the Leadership Institute takes conservatives – who believe in free enterprise, limited government, strong national defense, and traditional values – and turns them into powerhouse leaders who advance these principles in places where they can make an impact.** **If you have any questions about this Campaign and Candidate Workshop, feel free to contact us:**

name: Sen. Jon Ossoff
subject: On authoritarianism
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
MAGA is committed to eliminating Democratic seats in Congress so Trump can continue his “revolution” without domestic opposition.
#

_Our new reality —_
From classrooms to boardrooms to local governments and the press, Americans now fear political retribution from their own government.
Think of the CEO who bends the knee after public threats of prosecution. Or the newspaper owner who decides it’s safer to bury editorial criticism of the President.
The President and his lieutenants relish the power of intimidation. _And they’re using it._
***
Before my election to represent Georgia in the U.S. Senate, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminds me of countries where dissent is silenced by intimidation.
_“We don’t want any trouble.” “We’re not sticking our necks out right now.” “We don’t need an investigation.”_
**These things should never be said in the United States.**
***
During the confirmation hearings for RFK Jr., I noted the Republican Senate’s total capitulation to Trump.
Then they confirmed to lead the FBI (for TEN YEARS) a Trump loyalist who enters office having composed what many call an “enemies list” of MAGA’s adversaries.
_To lead the FBI._
***
Peter: Only by regaining Congressional power can we reverse this.
Remember: in 2026, I’m the only Democratic U.S. Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won.
MAGA needs me defeated and gone.
**_Help me defeat them in a landslide. Help fight back._**

subject: Heroes are not giant statues framed against a red sky.
body:
| | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.nTQp_FEIcSHl649vCJCicgFl4-m14JFRBrcYNYwfP9JIvmBnHU0VGpOT6rptE2SR6E78Ff5HQrMYZCajUoqbkOsfAEZQMwkF7Ez2d79gy1HYnpV-6Zb6QTwzR5_nufz1RV_iDg1LGygTJSnAgp529eockMjRvQUTtDjyAb0qyniYds4ybl16XeQvUowRp8-krnGAUJwqbouJPX3X6nExFFj-UnEja7mO0OgIpIb-y5bARjo0SQNh1aKvGICP5a0iEhUzA8MrklQsRUmp1YgCnat1CjU11dZ-zTMMopPxvVkUO1vIpMDU65hsnkY59DN7wEfDFlN4aP0ez2GEp1jkgQ/4f5/c0viUrtBT4GBlU2liF7jxQ/h0/h001.08aDQIAeEitONA4FD0qHr7SnioRlEvrK6jIbQxleLPQ) _"Heroes are not giant statues framed against a red sky. They are people who say, 'this is my community and it is my responsibility to make it better.'" - Former Governor Tom McCall_ **Peter,** **On January 7, 2019, I was sworn in as Metro President and have been serving ever since.** Over the course of these past years, I've run several campaigns, and each one was a start-up — the Neighbors Across the Region PAC (NeighborsPAC) is no different. As Metro President, I have:
* Worked to build 5100 low-income and affordable housing for our neighbors across the Region in 6 years.
* Launched an unparalleled effort to provide the services that end homelessness: 700 new shelter beds have opened in the region, joining the 2,200 that were open before the launch of the supportive housing program. And 5,000 people moved off the streets of our Region into shelter, temporary and permanent housing.
* Protected and conserved 20,000 acres of land for habitat conservation and restoration: From Newell Creek Canyon to Chehalem Ridge, Oxbow to Smith and Bybee Wetlands, there's nature for you close to home.
* Supported transportation projects that increase access to jobs, housing, health care, and education to create a safer place for us all.
* Improved transparency and accountability on all these projects and more so that we build trust with residents of this Region.

I started the NeighborsPAC with fellow Metro Council members Christine Lewis and Juan Carlos Gonźalez because Metro lacks a communication infrastructure with the public. **We need a way to stay in touch, help one another, and facilitate the support for forward-moving change and democracy that Metro leads.** We will use this channel to highlight stories in our Region where people are helping people and how you can help. I may be a transportation planner and engineer by profession from Wisconsin, but I am always committed to finding ways to serve the folks who live here, and Peter, **Oregonians want to protect this place.** But we also have to take pragmatic steps to protect it and grow. We want to provide a safe, stable Region where all our families _thrive_ , not just survive. This is where the NeighborsPAC comes in. By setting up the communication infrastructure and support now, we can mobilize Oregonians in the future and protect democracy. My entire elected career has been based on one question: "What would Tom McCall do?" I often come back to the quote I shared above, and that is why I find this work so important. **If building a stronger, more prosperous, and more sustainable Region is important to you, I hope you'll****join our movement. Let's be the people who say, "This is my community and it is my responsibility to make it better."** Together, _Lynn_ __ _The Neighbors Across the Region PAC is a new values-driven group supporting Oregon Metro’s work to strengthen regional collaboration, accelerate sustainability, and foster equitable growth. You are receiving this email because you support progress on the same critical issues that the Neighbors Across the Region PAC wants to address. But if this fight is not for you, or if we have the wrong person, you can[unsubscribe](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-gP0Xd1LL-Lub7Gk22PHy9WB3N4iTReVp1uLYRek5dN37x4lTxZ25-l6x1-yZ9smevQlxTRxMCr0lXW5obntThoRfX7Ho1B5_0dkvh2qmLM0Cg9EMb08lVGCHxlLlOYxo-vtezycOrwWfF4XRlUKO98brF5eotiF8tOJbtWenoG8FNg6qrc8bPl_XJzhITrsQRwK7zlxTR5SAj6LNmIv5i0vJ5jNfbyvaMFwn6NurvhTSM4O-AfcSK2qjJttmgamH3I6vPyD6tvrqlSjwgWYLyPUFvGFVBJKOEH_BTIdL_5gmiIRZGBKTMpDxrZswOhmTkFFe7Eidr_glkASARXUGYApSiQ_Sa5nW1QS30XD0_4T2wtwcJy5PjIlC24AqS82MTSNN8JIhIFlWia8_DoTNuiGz5PyVQ8c8tvBlGmpNWteVIv-D6-bITdy50rWBkbic/4f5/c0viUrtBT4GBlU2liF7jxQ/h1/h001.HrCSMez1cQXTOwE2OlyLrHrjXM-Cb5YvXkPv1HZ2xs8) at any time. _

subject: The MOMENT I launched my campaign:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VIVEK RAMASWAMY FOR OHIO
body:
The media ambushed me with fake news hit pieces, they published letters attacking my character, and the special interest bosses lied about my bold agenda

The media ambushed me with fake news hit pieces, they published letters attacking my character, and the special interest bosses lied about my bold agenda
The media ambushed me with fake news hit pieces, they published letters attacking my character, and the special interest bosses lied about my bold agenda
| |
---
| | | | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyN183Mi1SVS4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTkxMDktMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjdfNzItUlUuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE5MTA5LTM2MjMifQ/3UDCTjbfzpXR8Q98L0TfMQ)
---
Hello -

As you may have heard by now, I announced my candidacy for Governor. The first 48 hours were a whirlwind. We held four launch events across Ohio, my wife introduced me, and our two young boys took the opportunity to run around ripping off their suit jackets.

_**If I 'm being honest - I'm having the time of my life!**_

---
My campaign is drawing thousands of supporters in every corner of Ohio AND across the country who want a SLEDGEHAMMER taken to the system that prioritizes victimhood over merit, virtue signaling over morality, and illegal immigrants over American citizens.

**[That's what this movement is all about.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyN183Mi1SVS4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTkxMDktMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjdfNzItUlUuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE5MTA5LTM2MjMifQ/27iQzvfIMwabqquWpGo5Tg "That’s what this movement is all about.")**

But that requires seismic changes to the status quo - as I'm sure you can imagine my candidacy is ruffling a LOT of feathers in certain circles...

**MINUTES after launching my campaign, special interests, deep state operatives, and establishment power brokers moved to snuff out this campaign for good. **
| - The media ambushed me with fake news hit pieces
---
- They published letters attacking my character
- Special interest bosses lied about my bold agenda
- My Liberal opponent fired off a swarm of fundraising emails
- Even some "Republicans" took to disgraceful personal attacks

This is par for the course when you challenge a corrupt system. They come for you because they know it's the only way the gravy train keeps rolling.

_Our President knows this all too well. _

And just like we're seeing with him, the powers-at-be are coming for me fast and hard. That's why I'm coming to you now with a humble ask.

**I 'm hoping you'll help fuel this campaign across the finish line. [Every donation - especially in these early days - allows us to spread our message far and wide and keep this campaign afloat.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyN183Mi1SVS4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTkxMDktMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjdfNzItUlUuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE5MTA5LTM2MjMifQ/Vr2nB8mCfC2_xO6oaOSz6w "Every donation – especially in these early days – allows us to spread our message far and wide and keep this campaign afloat.") **

The amount is far less important than the number of folks who step up. So, with all that in mind, can I ask you for a donation to help fund a WINNING campaign?

| | [**CONTRIBUTE $4 HERE**](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyN183Mi1SVS4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTkxMDktMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjdfNzItUlUuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE5MTA5LTM2MjMifQ/LV_9uZ1JQJYE0fa_ahX9HA)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $40 HERE**](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyN183Mi1SVS4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTkxMDktMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjdfNzItUlUuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE5MTA5LTM2MjMifQ/GZ5PHZg8dNE4m6i0aKam0g)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $400 HERE**](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyN183Mi1SVS4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTkxMDktMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjdfNzItUlUuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE5MTA5LTM2MjMifQ/BtvnycFqLfwbppRZ6Kg24g)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT**](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDMyN183Mi1SVS4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MTkxMDktMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTAzMjdfNzItUlUuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjE5MTA5LTM2MjMifQ/0sd3h-AJwnGyBB3aOPKt0Q)
---

Whether it's a few bucks or a few hundred bucks, your support makes a big difference in this campaign. **Without it, I don 't like our chances. **

Regardless, thanks for everything you've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans in Congress.

Together, we'll make history!

God bless you, and God bless America,
Vivek Ramaswamy

* * *

---
**It 's Vivek Ramaswamy - I wrote you a personal message now that I OFFICIALLY launched my campaign:**

I am running to be a key partner to President Trump in my home state of Ohio. But I really need your help to win. That's why I am humbly asking you to join my inner circle and become a Founding Donor to my campaign today.

_It would be an honor to have you aboard._
---

---
To victory,
Vivek Ramaswamy
