| [](https://substack.com/redirect/634ed7ba-b056-4496-a366-33504125a9b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I recently [wrote about the surging price of eggs; they were so expensive that instead of a goose laying golden eggs, I joked, it was now chickens](https://substack.com/redirect/7e815868-3ab6-4285-94f9-a8964e25c53d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The price of eggs is such that use of the cliche "worth their weight in gold" abounds. Ironically, what's being overlooked is that if there is something that is worth its weight in gold, it's, well, gold itself.
The price of gold has been on a run as of late, recently setting records. So much so, in fact, that some are warning that we could be witnessing a gold bubble. Indeed, bubbles have been on my mind as of late - even more so than [usual](https://substack.com/redirect/f88f9dbd-6968-4dda-9fed-93896bd9d33c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- in part because this week marks the 25th anniversary of the infamous Dot Com Bubble reaching its [zenith](https://substack.com/redirect/60b68855-4d99-4ddd-afe2-6fff75c2e7ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). From August 1995 to March 2000, the S&P 500 tripled and the NASDAQ increased over 700 percent. After the bubble finally burst, the S&P 500 was cut in half and the NASDAQ saw 80 percent of its value go up in smoke.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..EtKsXQcN8y5AMAlPkNNX3-zvrssk0lF2XvXGhD1VNms?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=160004634)
How does gold compare? The precious metal has topped $3,000 per ounce for the first time in history and [Citigroup](https://substack.com/redirect/d2acda49-4d71-4e8d-94b5-1d1679299f7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) thinks it could go as high as $3,500. [Five years ago](https://substack.com/redirect/265fac11-b381-4142-ba97-2867dc23f346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- roughly the length of the Dot Com Bubble -- gold was about $1,600 an ounce; a year ago an ounce cost about $2,000. That works out to a roughly 88 percent increase over five years and 50 percent in the last year alone. Maybe not exactly Dot Com Bubble territory but still pretty stunning.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5ca9ffe4-829a-4f9c-8a80-4d46de7812c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: World Gold Council (www.goldhub.com)
So much so, in fact, that some are already ringing the alarm bells. Warnings range from market corrections to outright crashes. Forbes recently [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/2cfe261f-e439-42f8-953a-3fbd4fe066cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of "peak gold" citing Morgan Stanley's prediction that gold could drop as low as $2,400 per ounce by the end of the year, a decrease of 20 percent. The reasoning ranges from an end to the Russo-Ukrainian War to increased recycling to profit-taking.
But more importantly, I would argue that analysts who think about gold as anything more than a commodity are missing the point. Like all commodities, gold prices are determined by supply and demand. On the supply side, gold is fairly constrained. It's expensive to find, dig up, and store. How rare is gold? It's [estimated](https://substack.com/redirect/6d27f57b-3cbd-4ddf-aaf8-e5b0dc816e8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that only 216,265 tons have been mined throughout the history of mankind; if all of this gold was formed into a cube, it would only measure 22 meters on each side.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..EtKsXQcN8y5AMAlPkNNX3-zvrssk0lF2XvXGhD1VNms?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=160004634)
So, what about the demand side? Gold has limited practical applications; its primary uses are for jewelry and as a store of value. Jewelry demand tends to be variable and vary according to economic conditions, cultural preferences, and prevailing fashion trends. Consider Indian jewelry [demand](https://substack.com/redirect/dfc7fdf8-aa07-422b-bcbe-b04179cc8bf3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which accounts for 70 percent of the country's gold consumption. India has a unique cultural bias towards gold, both in terms of its use in jewelry, but also as a store of wealth/value. What this means is that gold demand can, has, and might again, turn negative in India... how's that? Indian families melt jewelry when gold prices get high. Over the long run, barring material fashion or cultural changes, I'd expect gold demand from jewelry to rise with economic growth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8463ed19-a1de-4c91-926e-c93ad067ca25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo by [Vaibhav Nagare](https://substack.com/redirect/13f9e812-529e-43e6-8a5d-ad268e540a0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://substack.com/redirect/85412eca-098b-4445-80ad-c5573ac72d5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
When it comes to investment demand, however, it's best to think of gold as an anti-asset. In fact, I've even suggested we think of gold prices as the reciprocal of market faith in fiat currencies - akin to one divided by faith in the US dollar. If you think the US dollar is going to weaken (either through monetary debasement or realignment in global currency usage), then you'd value gold more richly. As I [said on Bloomberg TV years ago](https://substack.com/redirect/28aa2913-a75a-49a5-9567-d625d63adb6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), gold price movements tend to be the inverse of changes in investor confidence in monetary policy. In a world of printable money, gold offers a non-printable option.
Unlike Tulipomania or the Dot Com frenzy, people aren't flocking to gold due to irrational valuations, but rather to flee them. Think of it as a Bizarro market; gold doesn't inflate because people suddenly value it more; it's because people value other things less. And if you believe, as I do, that **gold price movements are a sign of shifting confidence** , then the recent surge in the shiny metal's price is concerning. Investors are losing faith in the future of traditional currencies. But in the end, if gold prices do form a bubble that bursts, it will not be the result of irrational exuberance, but rather, irrational angst.

Are gold prices a proxy for confidence in currencies? | | | Mar 27 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- I recently . The price of eggs is such that use of the cliche "worth their weight in gold" abounds. Ironically, what's being overlooked is that if there is something that is worth its weight in gold, it's, well, gold itself. The price of gold has been on a run as of late, recently setting records. So much so, in fact, that some are warning that we could be witnessing a gold bubble. Indeed, bubbles have been on my mind as of late - even more so than \- in part because this week marks the 25th anniversary of the infamous Dot Com Bubble reaching its . From August 1995 to March 2000, the S&P 500 tripled and the NASDAQ increased over 700 percent. After the bubble finally burst, the S&P 500 was cut in half and the NASDAQ saw 80 percent of its value go up in smoke. How does gold compare? The precious metal has topped $3,000 per ounce for the first time in history and thinks it could go as high as $3,500. -- roughly the length of the Dot Com Bubble -- gold was about $1,600 an ounce; a year ago an ounce cost about $2,000. That works out to a roughly 88 percent increase over five years and 50 percent in the last year alone. Maybe not exactly Dot Com Bubble territory but still pretty stunning. | | ---|---|--- Source: World Gold Council (www.goldhub.com) So much so, in fact, that some are already ringing the alarm bells. Warnings range from market corrections to outright crashes. Forbes recently of "peak gold" citing Morgan Stanley's prediction that gold could drop as low as $2,400 per ounce by the end of the year, a decrease of 20 percent. The reasoning ranges from an end to the Russo-Ukrainian War to increased recycling to profit-taking. But more importantly, I would argue that analysts who think about gold as anything more than a commodity are missing the point. Like all commodities, gold prices are determined by supply and demand. On the supply side, gold is fairly constrained. It's expensive to find, dig up, and store. How rare is gold? It's that only 216,265 tons have been mined throughout the history of mankind; if all of this gold was formed into a cube, it would only measure 22 meters on each side. So, what about the demand side? Gold has limited practical applications; its primary uses are for jewelry and as a store of value. Jewelry demand tends to be variable and vary according to economic conditions, cultural preferences, and prevailing fashion trends. Consider Indian jewelry , which accounts for 70 percent of the country's gold consumption. India has a unique cultural bias towards gold, both in terms of its use in jewelry, but also as a store of wealth/value. What this means is that gold demand can, has, and might again, turn negative in India... how's that? Indian families melt jewelry when gold prices get high. Over the long run, barring material fashion or cultural changes, I'd expect gold demand from jewelry to rise with economic growth. | | ---|---|--- Photo by on When it comes to investment demand, however, it's best to think of gold as an anti-asset. In fact, I've even suggested we think of gold prices as the reciprocal of market faith in fiat currencies - akin to one divided by faith in the US dollar. If you think the US dollar is going to weaken (either through monetary debasement or realignment in global currency usage), then you'd value gold more richly. As I , gold price movements tend to be the inverse of changes in investor confidence in monetary policy. In a world of printable money, gold offers a non-printable option. Unlike Tulipomania or the Dot Com frenzy, people aren't flocking to gold due to irrational valuations, but rather to flee them. Think of it as a Bizarro market; gold doesn't inflate because people suddenly value it more; it's because people value other things less. And if you believe, as I do, that gold price movements are a sign of shifting confidence , then the recent surge in the shiny metal's price is concerning. Investors are losing faith in the future of traditional currencies. But in the end, if gold prices do form a bubble that bursts, it will not be the result of irrational exuberance, but rather, irrational angst. | | ---|---|--- VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI is an entrepreneur, consultant, scholar, neighbor, husband, father, volunteer, and professional generalist who thinks in multiple-dimensions and looks beyond the short-term. Self-taught to think around corners and connect original dots, he spends his time speaking with global leaders in business, government, academia, and journalism. He's currently the Chairman and CEO of Goodwell Foods, a manufacturer of private label frozen pizza. The April 1st Wisconsin Supreme Court election is a major battleground election in 2025 and right now, it’s shaping up to be tight. Here’s a rundown on the latest: _**FIRST:**_ Elon Musk endorsed Trump loyalist Brad Schimel in the race that will decide the balance of power on Wisconsin's highest court. _**THEN:**_ A group funded by Elon Musk spent more than $1.6 million targeting voters with deceptive ads just _weeks_ before the election! And another group Musk backs has spent over $6 million on get-out-the-vote efforts and digital media. _**NOW:**_ **We need to come together to make sure that on April 1st, Wisconsin voters aren't fooled by these lies.** Polls show this race neck and neck. A win for the NDRC’s endorsed candidate, Judge Susan Crawford, means that the people of Wisconsin will have a justice who believes in fair representation, reproductive freedom, and voting rights. But if Schimel wins, it would flip the majority on the court to one that supports a far-right agenda that is poised to ban abortions and roll back labor rights. It’s no wonder Musk’s organization is spending big to try to buy this seat. [**We can’t let them. Elon Musk is illegally firing thousands of federal workers and attacking Social Security.
We don't have to wait until 2026 to fight back. _
_ _I’m Donald and Elon’s worst nightmare_ \- and I’m running to deliver them a BIG defeat in this November’s Virginia General Assembly elections, where Democrats are defending a 51-49 majority.
**My name is Elizabeth Guzman - a proud mom, Latina, immigrant, civil servant, and union leader running to defeat a MAGA Republican in a toss-up district that Donald Trump lost.**
**I’ll tell you more in a bit about our fight,[_but if you’re ready to donate, pitch in before our first fundraising deadline on March 31._](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvhsqD6hnNNbCP7JMDskKO3DcwO3FPpifEsk6R5UXJAqV4L1yibpnnxAqS2wxuS2391adw55EaVet93JJXLwbcl4Y2X2ny7zvNHM4TiWSkviOe6wF9anNgAGC4E18pFY-b6sahirruqNAVv1rKoDVO_BJKSadI7AQpPzICZnDXzmsfkS2nfjw-hs0Zqh5efgjKik0-Z0Cw2C4Q9uy8pF9W76vP59R07ygHuEX1mGGeTbdl8nukAE9N1EPElj7XPCZGhQs0qpwJm3DV20kTSgqROZQJ7jm4miIZgg66C6Eb3qpG5vYRIVo2GQwaEXSOqaNb4gepDRahNAAQt-D457fR_/4f5/sI5CR3bCR1OZmtlQhc2ixQ/h1/h001.tU1KzffW83i4pmIXJ3ecW08F8vdja4USol_yHuTodc8)**
I immigrated from Peru with $300 in my pocket, working three minimum-wage jobs at the same time as I finished my education, becoming a social worker and union leader.
But when Donald Trump was elected President in 2017, my young American-born son asked me whether we should go back to Peru after Trump and MAGA Republicans disparaged Latinos like us.
After all our hard work achieving the American dream, I wasn’t going to let _anyone_ tell my children that they didn’t belong here.
I unseated an entrenched Republican incumbent, becoming the first Latina immigrant elected to the Virginia House of Delegates in its 400-year history.
I sponsored and co-sponsored laws that raised the minimum wage, gave teachers and firefighters the right to unionize, and kept abortion safe and legal in Virginia.
**Now, as Donald Trump attacks our communities, I’m running for Delegate again in one of America’s marquee red-to-blue races.**
**We’re facing our first fundraising deadline on March 31, and will need to publicly report how much we raise.**
_Virginia doesn’t have contribution limits, which means Republicans nationwide are going to write HUGE checks to stop us._
I need your help to show that thousands of people can organize and fight back.
**[Deliver Trump and Musk a big defeat. clean_body: | | | ** Donald Trump says immigrants “poison the blood” of our country as his administration puts our nation at risk. Elon Musk is illegally firing thousands of federal workers and attacking Social Security. We don't have to wait until 2026 to fight back. I’m Donald and Elon’s worst nightmare \- and I’m running to deliver them a BIG defeat in this November’s Virginia General Assembly elections, where Democrats are defending a 51-49 majority. My name is Elizabeth Guzman - a proud mom, Latina, immigrant, civil servant, and union leader running to defeat a MAGA Republican in a toss-up district that Donald Trump lost. I’ll tell you more in a bit about our fight, I immigrated from Peru with $300 in my pocket, working three minimum-wage jobs at the same time as I finished my education, becoming a social worker and union leader. But when Donald Trump was elected President in 2017, my young American-born son asked me whether we should go back to Peru after Trump and MAGA Republicans disparaged Latinos like us. After all our hard work achieving the American dream, I wasn’t going to let anyone tell my children that they didn’t belong here. I unseated an entrenched Republican incumbent, becoming the first Latina immigrant elected to the Virginia House of Delegates in its 400-year history. I sponsored and co-sponsored laws that raised the minimum wage, gave teachers and firefighters the right to unionize, and kept abortion safe and legal in Virginia. Now, as Donald Trump attacks our communities, I’m running for Delegate again in one of America’s marquee red-to-blue races. We’re facing our first fundraising deadline on March 31, and will need to publicly report how much we raise. Virginia doesn’t have contribution limits, which means Republicans nationwide are going to write HUGE checks to stop us. | | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/PnZKuGX4O7xctNHQPqufHZ7ApNzbla_g92USNNKKMbI8s_XywTuWtFY9YcEuIzmlgBmrVHb7Bb1AowaiJFl62zwuQJiROajGFXjWBPVQR9f4h0fwc1xHnWTraYVs-jrRLIey8VEPP4ycTKSmdoldUHia0xuShP0QY_CXJCiQr0p4Sa459kPp1-iFremNzJUJlBRPljoNAgkEy6zIKIRfePl3rnB0p0Jygo0dr7eJgCdskzZC9kjEqgpV-HQmT4f9IuA2l5pZtyFuY-FpoEQ1RNW93EgMTczn0rcgV8TH_uQ-BztMBNfAja-UzV1HmvxFJ2iy40dohUAdY__1ncllz1MKaJDnvhkkk1bGJ1x3aRlray2lR4pRa3LqjQ_cWMEzTzhpgDJd14ZqUVCpvPb_pxVfGIusVj1zzd3ulhgxfH-Wjg/qG9p9KTbAgQVS-8a-JpVh12pLrkKCKEW/7)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-12927052?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

Our time in Tallahassee so far has been very productive and exciting! Today, I want to highlight some of the things my team and I have been up to over the last few weeks. As the legislative session continues, I look forward to keeping the district updated on the status of my bills and important news from our Capital City. Stay tuned in the weeks to come!
---
| As always, my office is here to serve you! Please do not hesitate to [contact my team](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=dc7841395a&e=d1c1b9864f) if you need assistance with anything. We would be happy to help in any way we can!
---
| | **Week 2 Committee Meetings**
---
| In addition to meeting with constituents and stakeholders, my week was filled with the following committee meetings:
* [**Human Services Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=5ec3f5af99&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Justice Budget Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=ad6a13c1c0&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Economic Infrastructure Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=fb153b9282&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Intergovernmental Affairs Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9191b6ecb1&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Ways and Means Committee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=69781c2112&e=d1c1b9864f)

---
| | **In Tallahassee: Tuesday, March 11**
---
|
---
| On Tuesday, I met with Eric Friday, who is the lawyer expert in all things related to gun legislation. He walked me through several aspects of gun legislation happening this year and what to look out for.
---
|
---
| It was also a pleasure to meet with members from the Marion County Library System to discuss their work back in the district and legislative priorities for this session.
---
|
---
| I enjoyed a deep discussion with Secretary Michelle Branham of Elder Affairs to talk about how we can better serve Florida’s seniors and ensure they receive the high-quality care and attention they deserve.
---
|
---
| I had the privilege of welcoming representatives from the Alzheimer’s Association to my office. It was great to learn more about their efforts and how we can work together to end Alzheimer’s.
---
|
---
| Thank you to Leilani Glaser for taking the time to meet with me while she was in Tallahassee for Developmental Disabilities Day. We had a great conversation about what we can do to come alongside and better serve disabled Floridians.
---
| After speaking with Leilani, I met with Stephen Zedler, the founder and director of development of The Pearl Project. This organization is committed to bringing Trust-Based Relational Intervention (TBRI) to teachers, case workers, church volunteers, and anyone who works with children. I applaud their work!
---
|
---
| Tuesday concluded with a meeting with representatives from Empath Health to learn more about their organization and discuss their legislative priorities for this session.
---
| | **In Tallahassee: Wednesday, March 12**
---
|
---
| I had the privilege of meeting with the Florida Land Title Association, which advocates for property rights and the integrity and security of real estate transactions across the state.
---
|
---
| It was also great to meet with representatives from the Florida Association of Nurse Anesthesiologists. I appreciated them taking the time to stop by my office!
---
|
---
| I presented my bill, [HB 541 - Minimum Wage Requirements](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9e84fb3c18&e=d1c1b9864f), to the Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee. I’m proud to share that it passed favorably!
---
| I also had the opportunity to meet with representatives from Habitat for Humanity of Marion County and Cara Martin and Executive Director, Brian Armstrong, from the Southwest Florida Water Management District.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Go Team! My fellow Republican legislators and I had a blast at the annual King of the Hill Softball Game. I’m happy to report that the Republicans took home the win!
---
| | **In Tallahassee: Thursday, March 13**
---
| [ ](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b1afed2ca3&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| Click above to watch me present my bill, [HB 113 - Fleeing or Attempting to Elude a Law Enforcement Officer](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=956d9e9855&e=d1c1b9864f), in the Judiciary Committee! You can also watch a segment about my legislation covered by Fox News below.
---
| [ ](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=4ace9c1d46&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | **Receptions Attended in Tallahassee**
---
| My staff and I also attended various events throughout the week, including:
* **Library Day Legislative Reception**
* **Department of Military Affairs Social Reception**
* **Junior Leagues of FL Reception**
* **Puerto Rico Day in Tallahassee Reception**
* **FL Property Management CEO’s Reception**
* **FHA Hospital Days Reception**
* **FL Space Day 2025 Reception**
* **Habitat for Humanity Reception**
* **Kappas at the Capitol Kickoff Reception**
* **Republican Liberty Caucus Reception**
* **Moffitt Day Reception**
* **Drive Electric FL and Electrification Coalition Reception**
* **FL Professional Firefighters Reception**
* **FL Scouting Council Court of Honor Ceremony**
* **FL Alliance to End Human Trafficking**
* **FL Cattlemen’s Association**
* **FL Association for Women Lawyers Reception**
* **FL Keys Day**

---
|
---
| | Thank you for reading, and I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**

clean_body: Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin | | | | | | | NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN | Friends and Neighbors, Our time in Tallahassee so far has been very productive and exciting! Today, I want to highlight some of the things my team and I have been up to over the last few weeks. As the legislative session continues, I look forward to keeping the district updated on the status of my bills and important news from our Capital City. Stay tuned in the weeks to come! | As always, my office is here to serve you! Please do not hesitate to if you need assistance with anything. We would be happy to help in any way we can! | | Week 2 Committee Meetings | In addition to meeting with constituents and stakeholders, my week was filled with the following committee meetings: | | In Tallahassee: Tuesday, March 11 | | On Tuesday, I met with Eric Friday, who is the lawyer expert in all things related to gun legislation. He walked me through several aspects of gun legislation happening this year and what to look out for. | | It was also a pleasure to meet with members from the Marion County Library System to discuss their work back in the district and legislative priorities for this session. | | I enjoyed a deep discussion with Secretary Michelle Branham of Elder Affairs to talk about how we can better serve Florida’s seniors and ensure they receive the high-quality care and attention they deserve. | | I had the privilege of welcoming representatives from the Alzheimer’s Association to my office. It was great to learn more about their efforts and how we can work together to end Alzheimer’s. | | Thank you to Leilani Glaser for taking the time to meet with me while she was in Tallahassee for Developmental Disabilities Day. We had a great conversation about what we can do to come alongside and better serve disabled Floridians. | After speaking with Leilani, I met with Stephen Zedler, the founder and director of development of The Pearl Project. This organization is committed to bringing Trust-Based Relational Intervention (TBRI) to teachers, case workers, church volunteers, and anyone who works with children. I applaud their work! | | Tuesday concluded with a meeting with representatives from Empath Health to learn more about their organization and discuss their legislative priorities for this session. | | In Tallahassee: Wednesday, March 12 | | I had the privilege of meeting with the Florida Land Title Association, which advocates for property rights and the integrity and security of real estate transactions across the state. | | It was also great to meet with representatives from the Florida Association of Nurse Anesthesiologists. ---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104637329/535998319/86887870?recurring=true&refcode=WUEFE365_20250327_AntiEOQ_PL_v1s3&sourceid=1055877&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjc0NTNkZC00ZTBiLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=F5atVCNpe_Nf2nHsuiuj9T7Y0n2JwU3C9tQyuEoVeoo=) Peter,

It's the end of the quarter, and you know what that means...

You're likely about to be flooded with dozens — or even hundreds — of fundraising emails and texts. It's annoying, it's overwhelming, and it's frankly unsustainable.

**Here at EMILYs List, we know that the way we raise money online has to change.**

That's why we're launching Friends of the List: an exciting new way to support EMILYs List, improve your online experience, get access to high-quality, useful political updates — not just fundraising asks packaged as news — and build real community with other pro-choice advocates, all while saying goodbye to endless fundraising emails and texts. 👋

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dk7ka6ctkuxhecf01kzl2ccdpklsxdhoj85sbyv4g1114vq084jg28c0dbyj9fsumta0v9pnnnqo0c19vkms54321y5gtah5ldtd1aaam9azqo5llphyw6bm8l9w1hfejwcfcpci4occpcezart6&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stswz6&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stswz6&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stswz6&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stswz6&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dk7ka6ctkuxhecf01kzl2ccdzy1ifvf7b5oiqeie0pyhkg3jkox08e6uk8cycqhw6qcovef6pl8zofd4p3qndcoecukfqz65iuoxi6bmybc5b9h71ml976nvjivtubpp9gs6ugphlqsrhrhky3j6&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stswz6&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stswz6&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dk7ka6cjqyl68da9dvn30ttrjkskcxs377f1mrffy4i054ypv49xryz184qfgg4zvc0f0vh1yzkhi959zoggf3busstc38jgsm3uio7twfgeupkpby3u8erwqkhtellex70mby8rp6zzr1pcxntr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stsx00&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stsx00&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stsx00&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stsx00&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dk7ka6cjqyl68da9dvn30tts7xvqkppjl50sly7settglron9nidy63vqzuvnrvbrz3513mibnf78oh4stkcrbl95pmb078gp0kpcg83j9imfnzwdv74he1g3i5r9fvojsbzu2hr88poict1ulj7&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stsx00&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=stsx00&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: AOC, Ayanna, Ilhan, & Rashida
subject: Trump is counting on us to fail. Let’s prove him wrong.
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20250327-1288-foote&t=1001&akid=1288%2E342411%2E-PxMFP ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter — AOC,
Ayanna, Ilhan and Rashida here!

We’re reaching out because we’re up against a critical moment for our
movement. The Federal Election Commission’s (FEC) first-quarter
fundraising deadline is just five days away, and we need to raise $150,000
before time runs out. This isn’t just about numbers — it’s about
protecting our democracy, our communities, and the future we’re fighting
for together.

Right now, Trump and his MAGA-loyalists are doubling down on racism,
xenophobia, and policies that harm working families, immigrants, and
marginalized communities. They’re doing everything in their power to stop
progressive change — and that includes trying to unseat us and dismantle
the Squad.

But here’s the truth: our Squad is stronger than their fearmongering, and
our voices are louder than their hate.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250327-movement.t4AI-1&refcode=em20250327-1288&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1288%2E342411%2E-PxMFP ]If you stand with our Squad, please consider making a donation of any
amount to help us close the gap on our goal and kick off Q2 in the
strongest position possible.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250327-movement.t4AI-1&refcode=em20250327-1288&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1288%2E342411%2E-PxMFP ]Donate ››

Since we first joined Congress in 2018, we’ve built a powerful and
influential movement. From fighting for Medicare for All and a Green New
Deal to standing up for immigrant and reproductive rights, we’re proving
every day what’s possible when people come together to demand justice.

That’s why this fundraising deadline matters so much. Every dollar we
raise isn’t just a number on a spreadsheet — it’s a statement that we’re
not backing down, that we refuse to be silenced, and that our movement is
here to stay. But we can’t do it without you.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250327-movement.t4AI-1&refcode=em20250327-1288&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1288%2E342411%2E-PxMFP ]Peter, if
you’re ready to take our efforts to the next level to show Trump and his
henchmen that our Squad isn’t going anywhere, please consider making a
donation today.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250327-movement.t4AI-1&refcode=em20250327-1288&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1288%2E342411%2E-PxMFP ]Donate ››

Your contribution will help us hit our goal, build our Squad’s campaign
and organizing infrastructure, and keep pushing forward on the issues that
matter most.

This is our moment to stand strong, together. Trump is counting on us to
fail. Let’s prove him wrong.

In solidarity,

Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida

The photo above is from Nowruz, the Persian New Year, with my parents, my brother Darius, my two uncles and my late grandmothers. I am the proud daughter of Iranian immigrants who fled a murderous and theocratic regime during the 1979 revolution. This nation welcomed them and gave them the opportunity to realize a better future and live the American Dream. _**To this day, my immigrant dad is still the most patriotic American I know.**_ I was a 24 year-old graduate student when Donald Trump signed the executive order that enacted a travel ban affecting seven Muslim-majority countries, including my family’s home country of Iran. My grandmother, who was 87 at the time, had been hoping to have her sister come and visit our family, but unfortunately, she passed away before the ban was overturned. As a student working in international security studies, I had just finished up work assisting Syrian refugees in a camp in Jordan who had fled Bashar al-Assad's brutal crackdown, yet under the then-new Muslim ban, _these refugees would no longer be accepted into the United States._ These targeted and xenophobic policies have real and devastating impacts, and while we’re just three months into his second administration, Donald Trump is again considering a travel ban **that would affect as many as 43 nations.** **It's clear that Trump's concerns aren't about U.S. national security; they are about making it harder for folks who don't look or think like him to immigrate freely to America and seek the same dreams my parents did.** As someone who has experienced the direct effects of his policies, I always take him seriously. This proposed ban is about more than xenophobia. It would have real-world effects on our economy, our national security, and America's position on the world stage. Many of the nations affected are our partners in trade and innovation — bans will disrupt supply chains, deter foreign investments, discourage U.S. employers from hiring foreign workers we desperately need, and strain diplomatic relationships on which our economic growth relies. **_**[We have to use everything in our power to fight back against extreme travel restrictions and xenophobic attacks from the Trump Administration. It's clear that Trump's concerns aren't about U.S. national security; they are about making it harder for folks who don't look or think like him to immigrate freely to America and seek the same dreams my parents did. As someone who has experienced the direct effects of his policies, I always take him seriously. This proposed ban is about more than xenophobia. It would have real-world effects on our economy, our national security, and America's position on the world stage. Many of the nations affected are our partners in trade and innovation — bans will disrupt supply chains, deter foreign investments, discourage U.S. employers from hiring foreign workers we desperately need, and strain diplomatic relationships on which our economic growth relies. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = In Arizona's Third Congressional District, over 64 languages are spoken — a reflection of the incredible diversity that strengthens our country. Immigrants are an integral part of our culture, our economy, and our shared future. That's why I led over 30 of my colleagues on a letter directly to the president, demanding he reverse this harmful policy before it can hurt our economy, our perception as the beacon of democracy, and immigrant families, like mine. I won’t stop using my voice, my platform, and every legislative tool I have to respect the dignity and humanity of everyone. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Trump’s new administration is already beating his earlier administration’s record of corruption.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
For as low as $200,000, corporate CEOs can slap their corporate logo on Donald Trump dressed as the Easter Bunny

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2509%2E4032634%2E0tlolt)
---
Ahead of every Easter holiday, I often think about one of my favorite lessons I learned in Sunday school: By doing good and acting in service to one another, we can live a righteous life. Donald Trump, on the other hand, is thinking about opportunities to make money. That’s right, for as low as $200,000, corporate CEOs can slap their corporate logo on Donald Trump dressed as the Easter Bunny at the White House’s annual Easter Egg Roll event. On the campaign trail, Trump promised the American people cheaper eggs at the grocery store. In reality, he’s promising billionaire benefactors “valuable brand visibility” deals at the White House while grocery prices still remain high. We’re just two months into Trump’s second term, and his new administration is already beating his earlier record of corruption. Ceding power to the world’s richest man. Turning the White House lawn into a Tesla dealership. The list goes on. **Despite President Trump’s promises to fight for working families, he and his circle of billionaires are pulling the strings of government to enrich themselves. We need to call it out like it is: This is what absurd, illegal corruption looks like. Plain and simple. And we need to fight back.** My colleagues in Congress and I just sent White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles a 10-page letter sounding the alarm on the overwhelming corruption and vast conflicts of interest throughout the Trump administration, urging the President to:
* Reinstate the government watchdogs who President Trump purportedly fired, including all Inspectors General, the OGE Director, and the OSC Director, and commit to protecting those offices from further political interference.
* Thoroughly vet potential nominees for all conflicts of interest and refuse to appoint anyone who would enter with clear conflicts that existing recusal and divestment rules alone cannot resolve.
* Promptly issue an ethics pledge and ensure robust enforcement.
* Divest from his business holdings, in this case by either liquidating the Trump Organization assets or placing them in a truly blind trust operated by an independent trustee.
* Disclose his tax returns from the past three years.
* Revoke Mr. Musk’s power to profit from his efforts to manipulate the executive branch for his own benefit. Mr. Musk should also be required to promptly release his financial disclosure form so that the public can understand his potential conflicts of interest.

Look, if you’re going to talk about draining the swamp, be about it. The American people should have complete confidence that government officials are making decisions with only one factor in mind: **the public interest.** Not their own pocketbooks. Not what Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos want. Not corporate stock or shareholder value. The public interest. Democrats can’t just roll over and play dead while Trump puts his personal dealings ahead of our national interests. So I’m going to stay on this. I’m going to keep exposing this level of corruption to the American people and demanding accountability. And no matter what, I’m going to keep up the fight for broad anti-corruption reform in our government, like banning members of Congress and federal judges from owning and trading individual stocks, imposing an enforceable code of conduct on the Supreme Court, and getting Big Money out of politics. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | **Elizabeth Warren has been leading the charge for years to root out corruption from our government. Our campaign relies on small-dollar, grassroots support to do this work and take on the influence of Big Money in our democracy.**

Since that news broke, the National Republican Party rallied and in just a few days has mustered over $4.3 million which they’ve rapidly dumped into pro-Randy Fine and anti-Josh Weil ads. While we raised significantly more than our opponent at outset, Republican outside spending (money spent by PACs not candidates) has closed that gap and spending from national Democrats is nowhere to be found. Too many are comfortable with losing if it means erring on the side of caution. Why bother spending in a deep red district, best to keep our powder dry for a safer bet. Safer bets aren’t coming. subject: I’m in danger, Peter
body:
Our deadline is almost here.

Hi all,
You know I hate to send “sky is falling” emails. There is no need to fake urgency when the truth is scarier than fiction.
So I’m going to tell it to you straight: I’m in the most danger I’ve ever been in since I was first elected to Congress.
I want to explain why I’m so worried and why the upcoming end-of-quarter deadline is so important for our campaign. If you can rush in a donation right now to help us reach our goal, I’ll leave a link [_here._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104640558/536008578/2012213333?&refcode=E12713-20250326-EOQExplainer-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjI3MjM5ODQtNTgwYi1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0PxwjOvEFE-tg9YTdJmjT-vFyFrzi485Fkhn7AqBBl4=)
**Where we stand:** I’m one of the few Democrats representing a Trump district who is also leading the fight against the unconstitutional efforts we’re seeing in D.C. My outspokenness, however, puts a huge political target on my back.
**What’s coming next:** National Republicans just listed me #1 on their target list. This signals to all the dark-money Super PACs (especially Elon Musk’s...) that my district is where they should be sending their attack money. This deadline is vital - we have to scare them off with our grassroots strength.
**What decisions we need to make:** After this deadline, I have to make a major decision about how many staff we can hire and how soon we can get organizers on the ground. One of our strategic advantages in the past has been early organizing and investment in our Latino community. I want to make these same investments, but we have to reach our goal to do it!
**What I need from this team:** Well, I really need your help hitting our end of quarter fundraising goal! If we fall short, the GOP will double down and start their attacks early. I really, really don’t want that to happen.
With all this in mind, will you please send in the biggest donation you can to help us keep this seat blue? It’s the only thing that’s going to help us reach this goal.
Here's the link: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-March2025-FR-March**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104640559/536008579/2012213333?&refcode=E12713-20250326-EOQExplainer-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjI3MjM5ODQtNTgwYi1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0PxwjOvEFE-tg9YTdJmjT-vFyFrzi485Fkhn7AqBBl4=)
If you made it to the bottom of this long email, I’m impressed — thank you.
\- Josh

Hey Peter, it’s George. I’ll cut right to the chase:

The first FEC end-of-quarter deadline of this election is only a few days away – and I really need your help.

I know this isn't the first email you'll receive asking you to donate before the end-of-quarter FEC deadline, and it’s probably not the last, but I hope you'll give me a moment to explain why this particular deadline is so critical to our campaign.

This Monday, March 31st, marks the end of our fundraising quarter, and after this deadline, we’re legally required to send a public report to the FEC detailing how much grassroots support we have.

clean_body: Soon, our fundraising numbers will go public for the world to see. Peter—We’ve said it before, and we’ll say it again: Kim will work with any administration to get things done for WA-08. ---

| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2618261&post_id=160029618&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTYwMDI5NjE4LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc0MzExNDk2MiwiZXhwIjoxNzQ1NzA2OTYyLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjYxODI2MSIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.n3xWdDnrhpjCeMWsCgWh-WK89FwCxZsud2STcWe3pWE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

And just like that...poof...the prospect of a Special Election in NY-21 slipped away. He Who Pontificates Rather Than Leads has asked upstate [NY Rep. Elise Stefanik to remain in the U.S. House of Representatives](https://substack.com/redirect/7b761d9a-eb40-40d2-b300-9b386007ee9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), rather than proceed through the steps to become U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations (UN).
Poor Elise. She will be a Princess with no Palace in midtown Manhattan, as the Ambassador's residence near the UN is called. Stripped of her committee assignments and her cherished role as Republican Conference Leader, Stefanik will carry on as a regular Member of Congress. Don't fret. I'm sure she will find some turf to grab.
We can breathe a sigh of relief on behalf of the UN. I shuddered at the thought of her representing us in that august body of international peace. I was kind of relishing the idea of her getting muted at some point, which is what they do in the UN when someone goes "off" on a tirade. But I was terrified at the havoc she could wreak, adding fuel to the fires already ignited by the Trump administration.
Best tell Mike Johnson to watch his back. With the House rules that were put into place to get [Kevin McCarthy elected as Speaker of the House](https://substack.com/redirect/453736c5-f4ef-4efa-bc1a-165bcaf6d31c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), any single member can call for a vote to replace the Speaker. If I were the betting type, I'd put money on such a vote arising some time in May, around the time that Congress will be asked to vote to raise the debt ceiling. I would not be the least bit surprised to see a Speaker Stefanik in our nation's future.
Several supporters have written me privately to ask why I've not written very much lately. (By the way, you can always find me on BlueSky, where I post several times a day.) For starters, I'm trying to rebuild my law practice after taking several months to campaign for the November 2024 election in NY-21. It's Tax Season, which fills a great deal of my business (at least for now, while we still have an IRS). I also wanted to give the presumptive Democratic candidate, Blake Gendebien, the space to develop a platform and speak out without any competition.
Moreover, I must admit to being a bit stunned by the rapid decline into fascism that the United States has experienced. Perhaps more stunning is the lack of centralized party leadership from the Democrats. What the heck?
For decades, we have heard that if such-and-such happened, the Democrats would rise up, rally the people, and lead the way back into the light of democracy.
And if they dismantled the Department of Education, the teachers and parents would rise up.
And if they cut back on Veterans' Health Benefits (which many people told me was THE reason they were voting for Stefanik - because she Backs the Blue and supports the Veterans) they Veterans and their families would take to the streets.
And if they went for Social Security, the elderly would roll their wheelchairs and shuffle their walkers and shake their canes, surrounding the Capitol Building.
Ditto for Medicaid.
And surely the reason we could not ever afford to offer Medicare for all was that our US Health System was soooo far superior to all others that our citizens would not tolerate having a cutback in services - all of that pronounced repeatedly to me before we dismantled the National Institutes of Health (NIH), and took a power saw to the workforce at the US Health and Human Services and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
We have checks and balances - or so I was told.
We have courts and an executive gone awry would be reigned in.
And never - EVER - would we see a day in the US when ordinary people could be picked up on the streets by government officials and whisked away to offshore prisons without benefit due process. (What due process might there be to imprison someone off shore?)
Donald Trump won because he told people that the system is broken and therefore it must simply be torn down.
While Democrats protest or hold empty chair town hall meetings, the lack of centralized messaging has been more upsetting than the delivery of actions promised in Project 2025. At least we knew what the MAGAs had in mind. I honestly thought, or expected, that my Democrats would have had a more coherent response.
I don't want a Blue January 6.
I do want an uncompromising, clear, and even physical response that says that we will not simply had over our Democracy to adolescents who think it is acceptable to run [military attacks on an unsecured social media app.](https://substack.com/redirect/b2b315e9-f8e2-4f28-8aff-88c917f69fa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm holding out hope for the Indivisible "Hands Off!" March in DC and throughout the country on April 5. I hope we can keep the republic (lower-case letter) together until then.
I don't know if you have ever seen the Broadway musical, "1776". There is a beautiful scene, almost at the end of the show, when John Adams, alone in the chamber of the Continental Congress, asks "[Is anybody there? Does anybody care? Does anybody see what I see](https://substack.com/redirect/23ce7d3f-70dc-4efe-aa89-b35ad0b2e69f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?"
It's poignant. Time is running out. "The croakers all say We'll rue the day There'll be hell to pay In fiery purgatory." In a subsequent scene, Benjamin Franklin reminds us ""We must all hang together, or assuredly we shall all hang separately".
Through it all, John Adams (in the musical, 1776) reminds us, "Through all the gloom I can see the rays of ravishing light and Glory."
We have tough days ahead of us, and we are in desparate need of commitment and strength from Democrats. But it is vital that we hang together. Or we surely will lose this fantastic experiment in democracy.
I'll see ya out there as we look to restore our nation. It seems far-fetched right now, but I still believe that we can build back better once we wrestle the government out of the hands of the MAGAs.
There is nothing wrong with America that cannot be fixed by what is right with America.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins. I ran for Congress in November 2024 in NY-21. I continue to write about life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. _

We have tough days ahead of us, and we are in desparate need of commitment and strength from Democrats. But it is vital that we hang together. Or we surely will lose this fantastic experiment in democracy. I'll see ya out there as we look to restore our nation. It seems far-fetched right now, but I still believe that we can build back better once we wrestle the government out of the hands of the MAGAs. There is nothing wrong with America that cannot be fixed by what is right with America. If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins. I ran for Congress in November 2024 in NY-21. I continue to write about life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. | | | | | | | (C) 2025 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

This upcoming Monday, we’ll face our first FEC end-of-quarter deadline of the re-election campaign.

I know you’re probably receiving a lot of fundraising emails from other candidates across the country (trust me, my inbox is cluttered with fundraising emails too), but I’d love to make the case as to why a donation to my re-election campaign is the most strategic decision you can make this week.

But if you’re already sold on the importance of CA-45 to building a Democratic Majority, I hope you’ll consider making a donation before my first end-of-quarter deadline as a new Member: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tranq12025?refcode=EndOfQuarter**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/104643224/536016781/1943818218?amount=25&refcode=em_fr_2025.03.27_b1_dt_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmRmYWYxMzItNjEwYi1mMDExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=43K2dixBZgnMScri9ev7VPgLGDV5CRzmJ3Y-aLayML8=)

I’ll be incredibly honest: **There is no Democratic House Majority without winning this seat.**

No guardrails against Trump.

No stopping Elon Musk.

No protecting our communities. No safeguarding our healthcare. No defending our schools.

We can’t wholeheartedly do this without reclaiming the House. And we can’t reclaim the House without defending this seat.

Now look, I know you may be thinking that there are other competitive House seats that could make-or-break the Majority and wondering why you should donate to me, specifically.

Our team defied the odds last November. We were counted out, cast aside, and were the underdogs all the way through. And then, we made history by ousting an “untouchable” MAGA Republican incumbent and flipping this seat from red-to-blue.

**I know how to take on tough fights — and win.** I may be one of the Democrats that Republicans have pledged to defeat, but I’m determined to win.

body:
what pushes me...
| [ ](https://takano4ca.us/l/is08PIkshTYY?t=4o3azs39m0GN)
---
Peter, my path to Congress was not decided in smoke-filled rooms or carefully shaped by consultants in DC. **My commitment to public service was built across generations, and instilled in me by my family.**

During World War II, my parents and grandparents were sent to Japanese American internment camps because of racist, fear-mongering policies. They lost __everything__ and had no choice but to rebuild their entire lives after the war [](https://takano4ca.us/l/5Ym0FvFomaBA) _Despite_ being cast aside as second-class citizens, they instilled in me a deep sense of civic responsibility and commitment to public service. To love our country _despite_ its flaws, and to fight for the more perfect union that our Constitution promises. **Despite it all, they persevered.**

It’s what drove me to become a public school teacher for 20 years and eventually run for Congress. [](https://takano4ca.us/l/Zt2fkK7LsF4j) When I ran for Congress in 1994, bigotry would rear its ugly head when I was forcibly and **publicly outed as gay** by my Republican opponent.

Despite it all, **I persevered and was a sitting member of Congress when the Supreme Court legalized gay marriage in 2015.**

Today, we’re seeing some of that same racism, xenophobia, and homophobia again – especially from my MAGA counterparts in Congress. Attacks on immigrants, LGBTQ+ Americans, and women have been rising in recent years and threaten to derail decades of progress.

But despite it all, **we will prevail.**

[**Peter, hate is able to prevail when good people do nothing. So I’m asking for your support today – we can fight back against MAGA extremism if we band together! name: Elizabeth Warren (via Democrats.org)
subject: A plan that fits on a bumper sticker
body:
---
Derek, When some people hear the words “tax policy,” their minds immediately jump to percentages, dollar amounts, and spreadsheets. But fundamentally, tax policy is about something broader. It’s about who our government works for. Does our government only work for billionaires and billionaire corporations, or does it work for everybody? Does our tax system reward the rich, or does it look out for someone who’s putting together two or three jobs just to keep their family above water? **I’m bringing this up right now because Washington has major decisions to make about tax laws.** Donald Trump’s tax breaks for the rich that he passed in 2017 — mostly sucked up by millionaires, billionaires, and giant corporations — are set to expire. And Congressional Republicans are working to extend them, following Trump’s lead, who promised to cut taxes for his “rich as hell” donors. In the U.S. Senate, I’ll keep calling out GOP plans to slash taxes for the rich. I’ll keep putting forward plans to protect working families from devastating cuts. And I’ll keep fighting to make our government work not just for the wealthy and well-connected but everybody. And I won’t be alone. **People like you are raising your voices around the country — at town halls, on the phone lines, at local organizing events, at protests — and exposing the Republican agenda. If we can grow and sustain our momentum, we can create enough pressure in Congress and from the public to stop the GOP from handing billions more dollars to billionaires.** [Another thing you can do right now is make a contribution to the DNC as they organize against Trump’s disastrous agenda while working to elect as many Democrats as possible who will check this administration’s power in their cities, states, and districts.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?refcode=em_20250327_2943_fr&amount=3&refcode2=3082_22930333_qXwlCf&akid=3082%2E22930333%2EqXwlCf) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20250327_2943_fr&refcode2=3082_22930333_qXwlCf&akid=3082%2E22930333%2EqXwlCf)**
---
****
| **[CONTRIBUTE OTHER](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?refcode=em_20250327_2943_fr&refcode2=3082_22930333_qXwlCf&akid=3082%2E22930333%2EqXwlCf)**
---
****
While the GOP gets ready to give handouts to the wealthy, Elon Musk works from the inside to free up room in the budget with his illegal funding cuts — because tax breaks aren’t free, no matter how hard Republicans try to fudge the numbers.
Musk is targeting everyone from the public servants who make sure your dad gets his Social Security check on time to the scientists who could come up with the next big lifesaving breakthrough.
And Congressional Republicans are charging forward with proposed budget cuts that would hurt every community in America.
Take Medicaid, which would be gutted under the Republicans’ plans. It covers more than 79 million people. About half of all births are covered by Medicaid. Over a third of all children have health care thanks to Medicaid. More than half of all nursing home residents are covered by Medicaid. Many people are counting on Medicaid to pay for medicine that treats their cancer, the hip replacement they need to walk, the prescription for their child’s inhaler, or the nursing home that takes care of their uncle with dementia.
If the program is cut, the harm will echo through nearly every home in America.
But Congressional Republicans seem to think that’s a-okay if it means a billionaire can get a tax break.
Billionaires win. Families lose.
That’s their plan. You can fit it on a bumper sticker.
Help seeing a doctor, help covering grocery bills, help getting an education if you come from a family that can’t write a big tuition check — it’s all under attack from Congressional Republicans.
They want to increase costs for health care, food, and education for working people so they can decrease taxes for millionaires, billionaires, and giant corporations.
They want to reach into working people’s pockets to pay for billionaires’ handouts.
Taxes reflect our values. Taxes show what — and who — we value enough to collectively invest in. And Republicans are showing, pure and simple, that they value a handful of the wealthy and well-connected. Not the working people they claim to represent.
And they don’t want you to notice what they’re doing.
Newsflash: We are paying attention.
[And we are pushing back. I’m in this fight alongside you and the DNC, and I’m asking if you can make a contribution today to hold the line for our values. Together, we can stop the Trump-Musk agenda and defeat Republicans — up and down the ticket — who only look out for the rich and powerful.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?refcode=em_20250327_2943_fr&amount=3&refcode2=3082_22930333_qXwlCf&akid=3082%2E22930333%2EqXwlCf)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
Elizabeth Warren
U.S. Senator, Massachusetts
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?amount=3&refcode=em_20250327_2943_fr&refcode2=3082_22930333_qXwlCf&akid=3082%2E22930333%2EqXwlCf)
---

clean_body: We have just FIVE days to prevent Musk from buying a seat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court. | | | Peter — We have just FIVE days to prevent Elon Musk from buying a seat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court. He’s already spent over $20 million to prop up Brad Schimel — the MAGA extremist who tried to gut the Affordable Care Act in 2018.1 And Musk just cut a $1 MILLION check to a Wisconsin voter who signed his petition opposing “activist judges.” 2 This election will decide the future of abortion rights, labor rights, and voting rights in Wisconsin. And if Musk is able to buy a statewide Supreme Court seat, it’s not hard to imagine what the consequences could be nationwide — for billionaires wanting to buy their own judges, mayors, or other local elected officials. But imagine the message it would send to the entire world if working people are able to hand Elon Musk an embarrassing defeat in Wisconsin next week. With your help, we can help make that happen. With early voting already underway, the clock is ticking. That’s why we’ve also decided to spend $25,000 on digital ads — on top of our on-the-ground grassroots operation — to spread the word. This race isn’t just about Brad Schimel’s glaring flaws as a candidate. It’s also about the people of Wisconsin — and the whole country — sending a message to billionaires like Elon Musk: your immense wealth shouldn’t mean you can buy elections. In solidarity, Team WFP P.S. Want to go to Wisconsin? Our friends at Seed the Vote are offering up to $115 to help cover airfare, mileage, or a hotel for anyone willing to travel to Milwaukee and canvass voters before Election Day.
